**[LOW] `PackageIdParseError::PathTraversal` is reused for the unrelated leading-hyphen check, producing a factually false error message** *(not independently verified)*
`crates/callisto-model/src/identity.rs:31-32, 46-47, 64-65, 224-227`

**[LOW] `PublishTarget::Npm.restricted: bool` collapses three real npm access states into two, pushing scope detection out to raw string-prefix sniffing at the call site** *(not independently verified)*
`crates/callisto-manifests/src/npm.rs:200-209`

### Correctness / Bugs

**[CRITICAL] Cargo pre-publish version guard cannot parse `version.workspace = true`, blocking publish for every crate using standard workspace version inheritance — including all 10 of this repo's own crates**
`crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish_client.rs:193-236`
The pre-publish sanity check deserializes `Cargo.toml` into `struct MinimalPackage { version: String }`. `version.workspace = true` parses to a TOML table, not a string, so `toml::from_str` fails with `invalid type: map, expected a string`. The resulting error message ("must contain a [package].version field") is also factually wrong; the field is present via workspace inheritance. **Independently reproduced by Claude**: compiled and ran the exact struct against `toml = "0.8"` (this workspace's real dependency) with `version.workspace = true` — confirmed failure: `TOML parse error ... invalid type: map, expected a string`, exactly as predicted. Also confirmed every crate in `crates/*/Cargo.toml` uses `version.workspace = true`.
*Failure scenario:* `callisto publish` on any workspace-inheriting crate — e.g. `callisto-model`, `callisto-graph`, run inside this very repo — fails at the pre-publish check even when the on-disk version is correct.
*Recommendation:* Parse into `toml::Value` first, detect the `version.workspace = true` shape, and resolve via the existing `WorkspaceCargoResolver::workspace_version()` against the workspace root before falling back to a hard error. Add a regression test with a `version.workspace = true` member crate.

**[HIGH] Subprocess timeout kill only terminates the direct child; a descendant holding piped stdout/stderr can hang the reader threads forever, defeating `PUBLISH_TIMEOUT_SECS`**
`crates/callisto-cli/src/runner.rs:73-124`
On timeout, only `child.kill()` + `child.wait()` runs before joining the reader threads — killing the direct child doesn't close FDs held by descendants that inherited the same pipes (common for `npm publish` lifecycle scripts, `cargo publish`/`python -m build` spawning linker subprocesses). If a descendant survives, the reader threads block on read forever and `run_with_timeout` never returns, despite `PUBLISH_TIMEOUT_SECS = 300` existing specifically to bound this.
*Recommendation:* Spawn the child in its own process group and kill the group on timeout. As a secondary safeguard, bound the reader-thread joins with their own timeout so a stuck descendant can't hang past the stated deadline even if group-kill is imperfect on some platform.

**[HIGH] Cargo `round_trip` regression fix over-corrects: ALL compound ranges with an upper bound become non-rewritable, not just bound-crossing ones**
`crates/callisto-manifests/src/cargo.rs:411-441, 1394-1421`
An unconditional `else if prefix.starts_with('<') { return None; }` was added to fix a bound-crossing edge case, but it bails for *any* compound range containing a `<`/`<=` clause regardless of whether the target actually crosses the bound. The regression test added alongside it, `round_trip_compound_range_within_upper_bound_is_rewritten`, literally asserts `result.is_none()` — the test's own name contradicts its assertion, a strong signal the intended safe-rewrite behavior was never implemented, only tested around.
*Failure scenario:* A workspace dependency `">=1.0.0, <2.0.0"` bumped 1.0.0→1.5.0 (well within bounds) should rewrite the lower clause to `>=1.5.0, <2.0.0`; instead it's left stale at `>=1.0.0`, and a `RangeNotRoundTrippable` warning fires on every such cascade — easy to lose in a large monorepo's logs.
*Recommendation:* Compare the target against the actual parsed upper bound before bailing; only return `None` when the target would exceed it. Fix the misleadingly-named test to assert the corrected, non-`None` behavior.

**[MEDIUM] Bare `'401'`/`'403'` substring matching misclassifies unrelated publish failures as `AuthFailed`** *(not independently verified)*
`crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish_client.rs:649-661`
`detect_auth_failure` matches bare digit substrings anywhere in combined stdout+stderr with no word-boundary guard — inconsistent with the adjacent `detect_rate_limit`, which explicitly guards bare `"429"` against exactly this class of false positive (cargo's own `"429.1KiB compressed"` output). A byte count like `140312` contains `"403"` as a substring.
*Failure scenario:* `cargo publish` fails for an unrelated reason (e.g. tarball verification) after printing a size figure containing "403"; the failure is misclassified as `AuthFailed`, a terminal non-retryable error, misdirecting the operator toward credentials and skipping retry a transient failure might deserve.
*Recommendation:* Require contextual co-occurrence (auth-adjacent phrase) the same way `detect_rate_limit` does for "429", or drop the bare-digit checks and rely on textual signals alone.

**[MEDIUM] Python dependency-name matching for cascading rewrites lacks PEP 503 normalization** *(not independently verified)*
`crates/callisto-manifests/src/python.rs:314-345, 443-475`
Name matching only normalizes case (`eq_ignore_ascii_case`), not PEP 503 separator equivalence (`-`/`_`/`.` interchangeable). A dependent's `pyproject.toml` spelling a requirement with a different-but-equivalent separator than the depended-upon package's canonical name causes a spurious `DependencyNotFound` on cascade rewrite.
*Recommendation:* Apply the same PEP 503 normalization already used for the PyPI wheel-filename glob in `publish_client.rs`'s `pypi_publish`, consistently in both matching functions.

**[MEDIUM] Cargo dependency-spec rewrite silently no-ops for a dependency value that is neither a string nor a table** *(not independently verified)*
`crates/callisto-manifests/src/cargo.rs:336-351, 660-674`
No trailing `else` branch — a malformed-but-TOML-valid dependency value (e.g. `foo = 1`) falls through every match arm, no mutation happens, and the function still returns `Ok(())` as if the rewrite succeeded.
*Recommendation:* Add a final `else`/restructure as `match` that returns an error for unrecognized dependency-value shapes instead of a silent success.

**[LOW] Duplicate platform triples in `napi.targets`/`[tool.maturin].targets` are not deduplicated** *(not independently verified)*

*Recommendation:* Deduplicate before building `PlatformTarget`s; optionally warn when a duplicate is dropped.

### Security

**[CRITICAL] Arbitrary file write outside workspace root via unvalidated `changelog` path in `callisto.toml`**
`crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs:377, 439`
`changelog` is read straight from raw TOML into a `PathBuf` with zero validation — the same function explicitly walks `changesets_dir_str`'s components to reject `..` ~130 lines earlier for exactly this reason, but never applies it to `changelog`. The value flows unchecked through `walk.rs` → `commands/version.rs` → `apply.rs` → `callisto_changelog::prepend` → `atomic_write`, with `Path::join` silently discarding the base when the joined component is absolute, at every hop. **Independently confirmed by Claude**: read resolve.rs directly — `changesets_dir` has an explicit `Component::ParentDir` rejection block (lines ~244-256) with a comment explaining exactly this risk; `changelog` (line 377) has no equivalent check at all, just `raw_pkg.changelog.as_deref().map(PathBuf::from)`.
*Failure scenario:* `changelog = "/home/runner/.bashrc"` (or an `/etc/cron.d` entry) in a PR that receives normal review but no automated containment check. Once merged, the release workflow silently creates/overwrites the attacker-chosen file on the CI runner — a full arbitrary-file-write primitive.
*Recommendation:* Route every path-shaped config field through `callisto_model::path::workspace_relative` before storage. Add a containment assertion inside `atomic_write` itself (canonicalize parent, verify still inside workspace root) as defense in depth.

**[HIGH] `changesets.dir` traversal guard checks only `..` components, not absolute paths — same escape class, reachable for arbitrary file read/delete**
`crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs:244-260`
The guard only rejects `Component::ParentDir`; an absolute value like `/etc` has zero such components and sails through. `aggregate.rs`'s `root.join(&cfg.changesets_dir)` discards `root` when the value is absolute, so callisto parses arbitrary directory contents as changesets, and `apply.rs`'s `fs::remove_file` on "consumed" changesets becomes an attacker-directed delete outside the repo.
*Recommendation:* Reuse `callisto_model::path::workspace_relative` for `changesets_dir` instead of the bespoke `ParentDir`-only check — apply the identical fix to `changelog` above via one shared, tested containment helper.

**[HIGH] npm publish/view registry redirected by unvalidated `publishConfig.registry` from `package.json` — SSRF and credential-target confusion with `NPM_TOKEN` in environment**
`crates/callisto-manifests/src/npm.rs:196-198`
This is manifest-controlled data, not operator config, read with no scheme/host allowlist. It flows verbatim into `--registry <url>` for both `npm publish` and the pre-publish `npm view` existence check, run with `NPM_TOKEN` in the process environment (per the callisto-action). No check comparable to the leading-`-` flag-injection guard already applied to package names in the same file.
*Failure scenario:* A PR sets `publishConfig.registry` to a metadata-service or attacker-controlled URL; once merged, CI makes outbound/SSRF requests to it and, depending on `.npmrc` auth scoping, can leak the npm auth token to a non-npmjs.org host.
*Recommendation:* Validate `publishConfig.registry` against an explicit allowlist (the operator's `[registries]` config), rejecting unknown hosts with a diagnostic. At minimum restrict to `https` and reject link-local/metadata ranges.

**[MEDIUM] Tag-name validation omits leading-hyphen check, enabling git argument injection via `callisto.toml` `tag-template`** *(not independently verified)*
`crates/callisto-model/src/tag.rs:140-161`
`is_valid_git_ref_name` checks empty/slashes/`..`/control-chars/space/`~^:?*[\\` but never rejects a leading `-`. Git ref names may legally start with `-`, but `git tag`'s CLI parser treats a leading-`-` positional as an option, and no re-check exists at the call site (unlike the redundant guard applied to package names before cargo/npm/pypi invocations).
*Failure scenario:* `tag-template = "-f{version}"` renders to `-f1.0.0`, which passes validation; at tag time `git tag -f -f1.0.0 <sha>` is interpreted as flags, breaking tag creation or potentially altering tag-creation semantics.
*Recommendation:* Reject rendered names starting with `-`. Additionally pass `--` before the ref-name argument in `ShellGit::create_tag`/`create_floating_major` as defense in depth.

**[MEDIUM] Raw, unredacted subprocess stderr from registry CLIs is embedded in `PublishReport` JSON and CI logs with no secret scrubbing** *(not independently verified)*
`crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish_client.rs:649-661`
Full unmodified stderr from `cargo publish`/`npm publish`/`twine upload` is wrapped into `RegistryError`, serialized verbatim into the JSON report (no redaction anywhere in the codebase — grep for redact/scrub/mask returns nothing), and streamed to the terminal/CI log via `runner.rs`'s `eprint!`/`eprintln!`.
*Failure scenario:* A private registry URL with embedded basic-auth credentials, echoed verbatim by a registry CLI's own error diagnostics on auth failure, gets persisted to an on-disk report artifact and CI log.
*Recommendation:* Redaction pass on subprocess stderr before wrapping into `RegistryError`/`PublishAttemptResult` — strip URL userinfo components and known token env-var values sourced at invocation time.

**[LOW] Subprocess stdout/stderr captured with no size bound, allowing memory-exhaustion DoS before the wall-clock publish timeout fires** *(not independently verified)*
`crates/callisto-cli/src/runner.rs:76-98`
Neither the eager `read_to_string` nor the line-streaming stderr path caps buffered bytes; only the 300s wall-clock timeout bounds duration, not volume.
*Recommendation:* Cap accumulated stdout/stderr at a fixed size with a `[output truncated]` marker, while still draining the pipe to avoid the deadlock this code was written to prevent.

### Performance

**[HIGH] `apply_version_plan` re-opens and re-persists the same manifest file once per bump/rewrite entry instead of batching writes by file**
`crates/callisto-graph/src/apply.rs:75-128`
For every bump/rewrite entry, the loop calls `callisto_manifests::open()` (fresh disk read + full CST re-parse) followed immediately by a persist (`atomic_write`: temp file + rename + fsync of parent *and* grandparent). A single manifest with N internal-workspace dependencies bumping together produces N full read+parse+atomic_write+2-fsync cycles on the same file — hits the workspace-root `Cargo.toml` hardest under `[workspace.dependencies]`/`version.workspace = true`.
*Failure scenario:* An app crate depending on 5 siblings that bump together triggers 5 redundant full-fsync cycles on the same `app/Cargo.toml`, each discarding the previous iteration's freshly-reopened state. On CI with 20+ cascading packages this is dozens of redundant fsynced writes to a handful of contended files per invocation.
*Recommendation:* Group bumps/rewrites by target path before the loop, open each manifest once, apply all edits in-memory, persist once per file. Load `WorkspaceCargoResolver` once (reusing `ctx`'s existing handle) and route every inherited-version/dependency write through it.

**[HIGH] `status` command rediscovers the git repository from scratch for every package instead of once per command**
`crates/callisto-graph/src/changed.rs:23-53`
`changed_since_last_tag` calls `GitAccess::discover` fresh on every invocation, called once per package inside `status.rs`'s loop — for an N-package workspace, N independent repo discoveries plus up to N `commits_since` and N `git diff --quiet` calls. This is the exact anti-pattern `tags.rs`'s `fetch_all_tags` and `aggregate.rs` explicitly already fixed elsewhere in the same crate, just never applied here.
*Recommendation:* Thread a single `GitAccess` into `status()` and pass it into `changed_since_last_tag` instead of having that function discover it itself.

**[MEDIUM] `plan_publish` performs at least three independent git-repository discoveries in a single command invocation** *(not independently verified)*
`crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs:31-59`
`plan_version`'s `aggregate()` discovers via `GitAccess`, `ws.tags()` triggers a second independent discovery via `TagIndex::build`, and `plan_publish` itself calls `callisto_vcs::GitRepository::discover` directly — bypassing `GitAccess`/shell fallback entirely — just to resolve `head_sha`.
*Recommendation:* Build one `GitAccess` at the top of `plan_publish`/`plan_version` and pass it through everywhere; replace the direct `GitRepository::discover` call with `GitAccess::head_sha()` on the shared instance so it also gets the shell fallback (currently missing on wasm32).

**[MEDIUM] `matrix` command reads and parses each package's `package.json`/`pyproject.toml` twice instead of once** *(not independently verified)*
`crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs:63-246, 403-430`
`assemble_platform_target_group` and `assemble_runtime_versions` each independently read and parse the same two manifest files for unrelated concerns (platform targets vs. runtime version constraints).
*Recommendation:* Read/parse each manifest once per package into a shared value; have both extraction paths consult it.

**[LOW] `create_tags` issues one git tag-list round trip per release instead of reusing the already-fetched tag list** *(not independently verified)*
`crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/tag.rs:45-115`
`TagIndex::build` already fetched the full tag list once via `fetch_all_tags`, but doesn't expose it, so `create_tags_with_options` re-queries `git.list_tags` per release as an existence check.
*Recommendation:* Expose the raw tag list from `TagIndex`; check existence against that in-memory set first.

**[LOW] Per-package manifest discovery is fully serial, and the manifest cache's `RefCell` design structurally blocks parallelizing with rayon** *(not independently verified)*
`crates/callisto-graph/src/manifest_cache.rs:30-53`
`IgnoreWalkLocator::projects()` and `manifest_cache::open_cached` do embarrassingly-parallel per-package I/O+parse work serially; the cache's `RefCell<BTreeMap<...>>` is `!Sync`, foreclosing straightforward `.par_iter()` parallelization even if rayon were added.
*Recommendation:* Add `rayon` to `[workspace.dependencies]`, replace the `RefCell` with a `Mutex`/lock-free map, parallelize the per-project manifest loops.

Concrete, actionable dependency-hygiene items pulled from the findings above:

- **Use `camino::Utf8PathBuf::from_path_buf()` and `path_slash::PathExt::to_slash()`** in `callisto-model::path::workspace_relative()` instead of hand-rolled UTF-8 checking and unconditional `\`→`/` replacement (currently byte-incorrect on POSIX). Both crates are already declared dependencies with zero usages — either use them or drop them.
- **Use `dunce::canonicalize()` consistently** at all four path-canonicalization call sites (`locate/root.rs`, `locate/ignore_walk.rs`, `cli/workspace.rs`, `cli/commands/pre.rs`) instead of raw `std::path::Path::canonicalize()`. Currently used correctly in exactly one place in `callisto-vcs`.
- **Use `semver::VersionReq`** in `callisto-model::exec::check_git_version` instead of hand-rolled major.minor string splitting with silent-zero fallbacks.
- **Remove `serde_yaml`** from `callisto-graph` — zero usages, upstream-deprecated (`0.9.34+deprecated`), and its associated `GraphError::ParseYaml` is dead code. Either remove or wire up real YAML parsing with a maintained replacement.
- **Move `tempfile` to `[dev-dependencies]`** in `callisto-changelog` — it's test-only today but declared as a production dependency in a Layer 1 crate meant to have minimal footprint.
- **Consolidate re-pinned dependencies to `{ workspace = true }`**: `tempfile` (5 crates), `miette` (callisto-cli), `petgraph` (callisto-graph) currently re-declare versions instead of referencing the workspace pin, silently risking drift on future security bumps. Add `proptest` and `schemars` to `[workspace.dependencies]` — both used identically across 3-4 crates but never centralized.
- **Plan an upgrade pass for `petgraph` (0.6→0.8) and `schemars` (0.8→1.x)** — both sit on the most-exercised code paths (cascade engine, JSON report schema) and are 1-2 majors stale; the schemars migration should include a before/after schema diff.

**Reorganize / extract:**

## 5. Prioritized Action List

Ranked by impact-to-effort, not a restatement of every finding above:

1. **Fix the `version.workspace = true` parser bug in the pre-publish guard.** *(Small)* This blocks publish on the repo's own crates today. Parse into `toml::Value` first, detect the workspace-inheritance shape, fall back to `WorkspaceCargoResolver::workspace_version()`. Add one regression test.

2. **Add a shared path-containment helper and route `changelog`/`changesets.dir` through it.** *(Small–Medium)* Two independently-confirmed critical/high path-traversal issues share the same root cause and the same fix. Reuse `workspace_relative`, add a defense-in-depth containment check inside `atomic_write` itself.

3. **Make `PublishTarget` dispatch exhaustive and gate release-tagging on actual publish success.** *(Medium)* Replace the ad-hoc `.any(matches!(...))` checks with an exhaustive match; validate `PublishTarget.ecosystem()` against the package's real ecosystem at config-load time. This is the highest-consequence bug in the batch because its current failure mode is silent.

4. **Allowlist `publishConfig.registry` before it reaches `npm publish`/`npm view`.** *(Small)* Validate against the operator's configured `[registries]` map or restrict to https + reject metadata/link-local ranges. `NPM_TOKEN` is live in the environment when this runs.

5. **Fix `PackagePattern` ecosystem-prefix matching and wire up `GraphError::PackageSetMatchedNothing`.** *(Small–Medium)* Three independent audit passes found this; it's real, cheap to fix, and currently has a dead safety-net diagnostic sitting right next to it.

6. **Fix the process-group timeout kill in `runner.rs`.** *(Medium)* `PUBLISH_TIMEOUT_SECS` exists to bound CI wall-clock time and can currently be defeated by a descendant process — this is a reliability issue for exactly the automated pipeline this tool exists to run.

7. **Batch manifest writes in `apply_version_plan` and share `GitAccess` across `status`/`plan_publish`.** *(Medium, do together)* Both are redundant-I/O findings in the hottest command paths; fixing them together avoids touching the same call sites twice.

Everything else in the unverified bucket (documentation drift, dependency hygiene, undertested edge functions) is legitimate backlog material — worth tracking, none of it urgent enough to interrupt the above.

commit 7634e5fb79c94800260d8c52b37de51e93058abc
Author: Gabe Castro <gabe@techworx.dev>
Date:   Thu Aug 13 07:26:54 2026 +0200

    perf(graph): share one GitAccess instead of rediscovering per package
    
    status() called changed_since_last_tag once per package, and that
    function rediscovered GitAccess (native gix repository-open, or a
    fresh ShellGit on the fallback path) internally on every call -- N
    redundant discoveries of the same repository for an N-package
    workspace. changed_since_last_tag now takes a &GitAccess built once
    by status() before its loop.
    
    While in this code, fixed two related correctness bugs of the same
    class: plan_publish and plan_snapshot both called
    callisto_vcs::GitRepository::discover directly for head_sha,
    bypassing GitAccess's CommandRunner shell fallback entirely. Native
    gix is unconditionally unavailable on wasm32 (excluded from that
    target's dependency set), so head_sha was always unresolvable there --
    plan_publish silently omitted every release entry from the plan;
    plan_snapshot (a bare `?` propagation, no soft-diagnostic) hard-failed
    entirely. Both now go through GitAccess::discover(...).head_sha(),
    which gains the shell fallback. plan_snapshot's existing hard-fail-on-
    total-failure contract (docs/01-spec.md SSG.11 invariant #33,
    test_snapshot_sha_resolution_failure_is_surfaced_error) is preserved --
    confirmed the shell fallback's all-success-empty-output case still
    fails via CommitSha::parse's length check, not silently.
    
    Adds coverage: 5 new changed.rs tests (short-circuit paths, diff-quiet
    fallback, and shared-GitAccess reuse across multiple packages with no
    extra calls), plus a new snapshot_tests.rs test proving the wasm32
    fallback scenario -- no gix-discoverable repo but a working shell
    runner -- now succeeds where it previously hard-failed regardless of
    the runner.
    
    Note: the "N discoveries down to 1" claim is enforced structurally
    (only status() can call GitAccess::discover now) rather than measured
    at runtime -- native gix's repository-open cost happens via gix, not
    CommandRunner, so it has no footprint in this codebase's
    CommandRunner-mock-based test harness.

content.subject: Fix git ref-name leading-hyphen injection
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/tag.rs is_valid_git_ref_name has no leading-hyphen check; a tag-template like "-f{version}" renders to "-f1.0.0" which git interprets as a flag. Add the check, and as defense-in-depth insert "--" before the ref-name arg in ShellGit::create_tag/create_floating_major (crates/callisto-vcs/src/shell.rs).

content.subject: Redact secrets from subprocess stderr before embedding in reports/logs
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish_client.rs embeds raw subprocess stderr verbatim into RegistryError/PublishReport JSON and CI logs with zero scrubbing. Add a redaction pass (strip URL userinfo, known token env-var values) before wrapping stderr into any error/report type.

content.subject: Bound subprocess stdout/stderr buffer size
content.description: crates/callisto-cli/src/runner.rs's run/run_with_timeout capture stdout/stderr with no byte cap (only the 300s wall-clock timeout bounds anything). Cap accumulated output at a fixed size with a "[output truncated]" marker while still draining the pipe to avoid reintroducing the deadlock commit 6e16212 fixed.

content.subject: Fix Cargo dependency-spec silent no-op for unrecognized value shapes
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/cargo.rs: CargoToml::update_dependency_spec (~347-374) and WorkspaceCargoResolver::write_dependency (~684-699) both fall through to Ok(()) with zero mutation when a dependency TOML value is neither string nor table. Add a trailing else/error branch to both, same pattern in both places.

content.subject: Fix bare 401/403 substring auth-failure misclassification
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish_client.rs detect_auth_failure (~697-709) does bare .contains("401")/.contains("403") with no word-boundary guard, unlike the adjacent detect_rate_limit's guard against bare "429". A byte count like "140312" would misclassify as AuthFailed. Add the same contextual co-occurrence guard.

content.subject: Fix detect_npm_role/role_to_triple ABI mismatch for Linux napi targets
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/walk.rs detect_npm_role (~454) always sets abi: None, but napi.rs::role_to_triple's Linux match arms all require Some("gnu")/Some("musl")/Some("gnueabihf") — a real disk-discovered Linux napi package can never round-trip. Give detect_npm_role access to ABI inference (napi-rs package-name suffix convention) or make role_to_triple treat abi:None as a wildcard on Linux.

content.subject: Add PEP 503 normalization to Python dependency-name matching
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/python.rs update_dependency_spec (line 330) and update_optional_dependencies (line 458) only case-fold names (.eq_ignore_ascii_case), not PEP 503 separator equivalence (-/_/. interchangeable). Apply the same PEP 503 normalization already used for the PyPI wheel-filename glob in publish_client.rs's pypi_publish.

content.subject: Dedupe platform triples in matrix.rs
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs assemble_platform_target_group (306-338) doesn't dedupe triples read from napi.targets/[tool.maturin].targets before building PlatformTargets — a copy-paste duplicate in a hand-maintained manifest produces duplicate CI matrix jobs. Dedupe before construction; optionally warn on a dropped duplicate.

content.subject: Add PackageId::resolve_unique() safe API and migrate remaining .find()-over-matches() site
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/identity.rs PackageId::matches() returns a bare bool for an ambiguity-prone operation; commit 84e3a73 fixed 2 call sites by hand (aggregate.rs, status.rs) but never added a safe API, so the pattern isn't enforced. Add a resolve_unique() method encapsulating collect-and-error, migrate the two already-fixed call sites to use it, and migrate crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs's resolve_package_config (still first-match .find()) if that call site's semantics genuinely need uniqueness (verify it's not intentionally most-specific-wins first).

content.subject: Convert PreMajorInferencePolicy to a proper 3-state enum
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs PreMajorInferencePolicy (135-146) models a closed 3-state policy as two independent public bools, permitting an unreachable-via-parser 4th combination via plain struct literal. Replace with enum PreMajorInferencePolicy { Off, Conservative, ConservativeFeat }, update parse_pre_major_policy and all call sites.

content.subject: Split PackageIdParseError::PathTraversal from leading-hyphen error
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/identity.rs reuses PackageIdParseError::PathTraversal (message "contains path traversal `..`") for the unrelated leading-hyphen check (lines 31-32, 46-47, 64-65, 226-227) even when the input has no "..". Add a dedicated LeadingHyphen variant with an accurate message; add message-content assertions to the existing test.

content.subject: Model PublishTarget::Npm access as a 3-state enum instead of bool
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/npm.rs PublishTarget::Npm.restricted: bool collapses absent/public/restricted npm access into two states, forcing crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs (~224) to re-derive scope via starts_with('@') string-sniffing. Model as access: Option<NpmAccess> reusing the existing NpmAccess enum.

content.subject: Resolve IdentityResolver duplication — delete if dead, else route through Manifest trait
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/identity.rs IdentityResolver::resolve hand-parses manifests directly instead of using callisto-manifests' Manifest::package_name(). Verify (walk.rs:58-63 suggests it may no longer be called at all, having been replaced by locator-resolved proj.id) whether IdentityResolver has any live callers; if dead, remove it; if live, route it through the Manifest trait's open()/.package_name() instead of duplicating the parsing.

content.subject: Add probe/quiet mode to CommandRunner for existence-check subprocess calls
content.description: crates/callisto-cli/src/runner.rs unconditionally streams subprocess stderr live with no "internal probe" signal. SubprocessRegistryClient::npm_is_published's npm view existence check streams raw npm stderr live even on the expected 404-shaped "not published yet" result, looking like a failure during every first-time publish. Add a run_quiet/probe variant to CommandRunner and use it for is_published-style calls; reserve live streaming for the actual mutating publish() call.

content.subject: Resolve Layer 1 AGPL dev-dependency on callisto-fixtures
content.description: crates/callisto-model/Cargo.toml and crates/callisto-format/Cargo.toml both dev-depend on AGPL-licensed callisto-fixtures, contradicting CLAUDE.md invariant #4's "Layer 1 must never depend on AGPL crates" (no dev-dependency carve-out stated). Either document the dev-only exception explicitly in ARCHITECTURE.md, or extract the shared test doubles into a small MIT/Apache dev-fixtures crate — decide which with the user before implementing.

content.subject: Consolidate plan_publish to one shared GitAccess + add fallback test
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs still performs 2 independent GitAccess::discover calls (head_sha at line 111, plus one implicit inside ws.tags()->TagIndex::build) instead of 1 shared instance the way status() now does it (commit 7634e5f). Consolidate into one shared GitAccess, and add a dedicated publish_tests.rs test proving plan.releases populates correctly via the shell fallback when gix is unavailable (currently only the total-git-failure path is tested for publish).

content.subject: Eliminate matrix.rs's double manifest parse per package
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs assemble_platform_target_group (63-246) and assemble_runtime_versions (368-396) each independently read+parse the same package.json/pyproject.toml per package. Read/parse each manifest once per package into a shared value; have both extraction paths consult it.

content.subject: Reuse TagIndex's tag list in create_tags instead of re-querying git
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/tag.rs create_tags_with_options (line 79) calls git.list_tags per release as an existence check even though TagIndex::build already fetched the full tag list once via fetch_all_tags. Expose the raw tag list from TagIndex and check existence against that in-memory set first.

content.subject: Fix workspace_relative to use camino/path-slash instead of hand-rolled parsing
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/path.rs workspace_relative() hand-rolls path normalization with .replace('\\', "/") which is byte-incorrect on Unix (treats a literal backslash, a legal filename byte, as a separator). camino and path-slash are both already declared workspace dependencies with zero usages anywhere. Use camino::Utf8PathBuf::from_path_buf() and path_slash::PathExt::to_slash(), or remove the unused deps if the hand-rolled logic turns out intentional (unlikely given the confirmed Unix bug).

content.subject: Apply dunce::canonicalize consistently at remaining path-canonicalization sites
content.description: Only callisto-vcs/src/lib.rs:200 uses dunce::canonicalize (strips Windows \\?\ extended-length prefixes); crates/callisto-graph/src/locate/root.rs:7, locate/ignore_walk.rs:24, callisto-cli/src/workspace.rs:13 (load_workspace), and callisto-cli/src/commands/pre.rs:124 all call raw std::path::Path::canonicalize(). Add dunce as a dependency to callisto-graph/callisto-cli and replace all four raw calls.

content.subject: Move tempfile to dev-dependencies in callisto-changelog
content.description: crates/callisto-changelog/Cargo.toml declares tempfile under [dependencies] but every usage (write.rs:198,239,283,318,352) is inside #[cfg(test)]. Move to [dev-dependencies].

content.subject: Remove unused serde_yaml dependency and dead GraphError::ParseYaml variant
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/Cargo.toml declares serde_yaml with zero usages anywhere in src; GraphError::ParseYaml (error.rs:289) is never constructed. Remove both, or wire up real YAML parsing (e.g. for pnpm-workspace.yaml, referenced but never parsed) with a maintained replacement if that's actually wanted — confirm with the user which before implementing.

content.subject: Use semver crate in check_git_version instead of hand-rolled parsing
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/exec.rs check_git_version (93-122) hand-splits on '.' with .unwrap_or(0) fallbacks that silently coerce non-numeric segments to 0, instead of using semver::VersionReq (already a workspace dep, already imported by callisto_model::version in the same crate). Parse REQUIRED_GIT itself via semver to derive the comparison floor; surface a distinct diagnostic on genuine parse failure instead of silently defaulting to zero.

content.subject: Centralize re-pinned workspace dependencies
content.description: tempfile (5 crates), miette (callisto-cli), petgraph (callisto-graph) re-declare versions locally instead of {workspace = true}. proptest (4 crates) and schemars (3 crates) are used identically across multiple crates but never centralized in [workspace.dependencies] at all. Convert re-pinned deps to workspace=true; add proptest/schemars to [workspace.dependencies].

content.subject: Document callisto matrix in docs/00-design.md and docs/01-spec.md
content.description: docs/00-design.md has zero mentions of matrix/PlatformTarget/MatrixReport/napi-maturin auto-discovery. docs/01-spec.md has exactly one incidental reference to "§SPEC-004" with no actual SPEC-004 section, despite code doc comments referencing AC-001 through AC-018. Add a full crate-letter-numbered section to docs/01-spec.md (schema, platform-triple table, acceptance criteria) and a narrative section to docs/00-design.md.

content.subject: Add callisto-vcs to crate architecture docs
content.description: docs/01-spec.md says "Nine crates" (there are ten); the crate-letter legend (lines 55-58) has no letter for callisto-vcs; the ASCII dependency diagram (70-90) has no callisto-vcs box and a misaligned callisto-changelog row. callisto-vcs is only mentioned in a late appendix (§13.6). Add callisto-vcs to the crate-letter legend, give it a full spec section matching the other nine crates, fix the diagram, correct "nine" to "ten."

content.subject: Doc-comment DiagnosticCode enum and its variants
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/diagnostic.rs DiagnosticCode enum (91-108, now 20 variants) has zero doc comments on the enum or any variant — this is the discriminator serialized into every JSON diagnostic and consumed by CI tooling. Doc-comment each variant with its trigger condition and default severity, mirroring the density already present on RegistryError's variants.

content.subject: Doc-comment solve_cascade, RateLimitPolicy, TimeProvider, REQUIRED_GIT, RuntimeEcosystem
content.description: Five undocumented public API surfaces on freshly-touched or architecturally central code, each inconsistent with well-documented siblings in the same file: solve_cascade (crates/callisto-graph/src/cascade.rs:167, the ~200-line worklist algorithm at the heart of the largest crate), RateLimitPolicy/TimeProvider (crates/callisto-model/src/registry.rs:79-86, the retry/backoff extension points), REQUIRED_GIT (crates/callisto-model/src/exec.rs:4), RuntimeEcosystem (crates/callisto-model/src/matrix.rs:84-89). Bring doc-comment density in line with each file's existing documented neighbors.

content.subject: Fix ARCHITECTURE.md factual errors
content.description: ARCHITECTURE.md:123 claims callisto-changelog depends on pulldown-cmark (it doesn't — the renderer builds Markdown by hand). ARCHITECTURE.md's Layer1 mermaid subgraph (90-105) is titled "Permissive" but contains two AGPL-licensed crates (callisto-conventional, callisto-changelog), contradicting the licensing table two lines below and CLAUDE.md invariant #4's narrower "Layer 1" scope. Correct the dependency claim; rename the subgraph to avoid the permissiveness claim and reconcile "Layer 1" terminology between the two docs.

content.subject: Fix git ref-name leading-hyphen injection
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/tag.rs is_valid_git_ref_name has no leading-hyphen check; a tag-template like "-f{version}" renders to "-f1.0.0" which git interprets as a flag. Add the check, and as defense-in-depth insert "--" before the ref-name arg in ShellGit::create_tag/create_floating_major (crates/callisto-vcs/src/shell.rs).

content.subject: Redact secrets from subprocess stderr before embedding in reports/logs
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish_client.rs embeds raw subprocess stderr verbatim into RegistryError/PublishReport JSON and CI logs with zero scrubbing. Add a redaction pass (strip URL userinfo, known token env-var values) before wrapping stderr into any error/report type.

content.subject: Bound subprocess stdout/stderr buffer size
content.description: crates/callisto-cli/src/runner.rs's run/run_with_timeout capture stdout/stderr with no byte cap (only the 300s wall-clock timeout bounds anything). Cap accumulated output at a fixed size with a "[output truncated]" marker while still draining the pipe to avoid reintroducing the deadlock commit 6e16212 fixed.

content.subject: Fix Cargo dependency-spec silent no-op for unrecognized value shapes
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/cargo.rs: CargoToml::update_dependency_spec (~347-374) and WorkspaceCargoResolver::write_dependency (~684-699) both fall through to Ok(()) with zero mutation when a dependency TOML value is neither string nor table. Add a trailing else/error branch to both, same pattern in both places.

content.subject: Fix bare 401/403 substring auth-failure misclassification
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish_client.rs detect_auth_failure (~697-709) does bare .contains("401")/.contains("403") with no word-boundary guard, unlike the adjacent detect_rate_limit's guard against bare "429". A byte count like "140312" would misclassify as AuthFailed. Add the same contextual co-occurrence guard.

content.subject: Fix detect_npm_role/role_to_triple ABI mismatch for Linux napi targets
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/walk.rs detect_npm_role (~454) always sets abi: None, but napi.rs::role_to_triple's Linux match arms all require Some("gnu")/Some("musl")/Some("gnueabihf") — a real disk-discovered Linux napi package can never round-trip. Give detect_npm_role access to ABI inference (napi-rs package-name suffix convention) or make role_to_triple treat abi:None as a wildcard on Linux.

content.subject: Add PEP 503 normalization to Python dependency-name matching
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/python.rs update_dependency_spec (line 330) and update_optional_dependencies (line 458) only case-fold names (.eq_ignore_ascii_case), not PEP 503 separator equivalence (-/_/. interchangeable). Apply the same PEP 503 normalization already used for the PyPI wheel-filename glob in publish_client.rs's pypi_publish.

content.subject: Dedupe platform triples in matrix.rs
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs assemble_platform_target_group (306-338) doesn't dedupe triples read from napi.targets/[tool.maturin].targets before building PlatformTargets — a copy-paste duplicate in a hand-maintained manifest produces duplicate CI matrix jobs. Dedupe before construction; optionally warn on a dropped duplicate.

content.subject: Add PackageId::resolve_unique() safe API and migrate remaining .find()-over-matches() site
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/identity.rs PackageId::matches() returns a bare bool for an ambiguity-prone operation; commit 84e3a73 fixed 2 call sites by hand (aggregate.rs, status.rs) but never added a safe API, so the pattern isn't enforced. Add a resolve_unique() method encapsulating collect-and-error, migrate the two already-fixed call sites to use it, and migrate crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs's resolve_package_config (still first-match .find()) if that call site's semantics genuinely need uniqueness (verify it's not intentionally most-specific-wins first).

content.subject: Convert PreMajorInferencePolicy to a proper 3-state enum
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs PreMajorInferencePolicy (135-146) models a closed 3-state policy as two independent public bools, permitting an unreachable-via-parser 4th combination via plain struct literal. Replace with enum PreMajorInferencePolicy { Off, Conservative, ConservativeFeat }, update parse_pre_major_policy and all call sites.

content.subject: Split PackageIdParseError::PathTraversal from leading-hyphen error
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/identity.rs reuses PackageIdParseError::PathTraversal (message "contains path traversal `..`") for the unrelated leading-hyphen check (lines 31-32, 46-47, 64-65, 226-227) even when the input has no "..". Add a dedicated LeadingHyphen variant with an accurate message; add message-content assertions to the existing test.

content.subject: Model PublishTarget::Npm access as a 3-state enum instead of bool
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/npm.rs PublishTarget::Npm.restricted: bool collapses absent/public/restricted npm access into two states, forcing crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs (~224) to re-derive scope via starts_with('@') string-sniffing. Model as access: Option<NpmAccess> reusing the existing NpmAccess enum.

content.subject: Resolve IdentityResolver duplication — delete if dead, else route through Manifest trait
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/identity.rs IdentityResolver::resolve hand-parses manifests directly instead of using callisto-manifests' Manifest::package_name(). Verify (walk.rs:58-63 suggests it may no longer be called at all, having been replaced by locator-resolved proj.id) whether IdentityResolver has any live callers; if dead, remove it; if live, route it through the Manifest trait's open()/.package_name() instead of duplicating the parsing.

content.subject: Add probe/quiet mode to CommandRunner for existence-check subprocess calls
content.description: crates/callisto-cli/src/runner.rs unconditionally streams subprocess stderr live with no "internal probe" signal. SubprocessRegistryClient::npm_is_published's npm view existence check streams raw npm stderr live even on the expected 404-shaped "not published yet" result, looking like a failure during every first-time publish. Add a run_quiet/probe variant to CommandRunner and use it for is_published-style calls; reserve live streaming for the actual mutating publish() call.

content.subject: Resolve Layer 1 AGPL dev-dependency on callisto-fixtures
content.description: crates/callisto-model/Cargo.toml and crates/callisto-format/Cargo.toml both dev-depend on AGPL-licensed callisto-fixtures, contradicting CLAUDE.md invariant #4's "Layer 1 must never depend on AGPL crates" (no dev-dependency carve-out stated). Either document the dev-only exception explicitly in ARCHITECTURE.md, or extract the shared test doubles into a small MIT/Apache dev-fixtures crate — decide which with the user before implementing.

content.subject: Consolidate plan_publish to one shared GitAccess + add fallback test
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs still performs 2 independent GitAccess::discover calls (head_sha at line 111, plus one implicit inside ws.tags()->TagIndex::build) instead of 1 shared instance the way status() now does it (commit 7634e5f). Consolidate into one shared GitAccess, and add a dedicated publish_tests.rs test proving plan.releases populates correctly via the shell fallback when gix is unavailable (currently only the total-git-failure path is tested for publish).

content.subject: Eliminate matrix.rs's double manifest parse per package
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs assemble_platform_target_group (63-246) and assemble_runtime_versions (368-396) each independently read+parse the same package.json/pyproject.toml per package. Read/parse each manifest once per package into a shared value; have both extraction paths consult it.

content.subject: Reuse TagIndex's tag list in create_tags instead of re-querying git
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/tag.rs create_tags_with_options (line 79) calls git.list_tags per release as an existence check even though TagIndex::build already fetched the full tag list once via fetch_all_tags. Expose the raw tag list from TagIndex and check existence against that in-memory set first.

content.subject: Fix workspace_relative to use camino/path-slash instead of hand-rolled parsing
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/path.rs workspace_relative() hand-rolls path normalization with .replace('\\', "/") which is byte-incorrect on Unix (treats a literal backslash, a legal filename byte, as a separator). camino and path-slash are both already declared workspace dependencies with zero usages anywhere. Use camino::Utf8PathBuf::from_path_buf() and path_slash::PathExt::to_slash(), or remove the unused deps if the hand-rolled logic turns out intentional (unlikely given the confirmed Unix bug).

content.subject: Apply dunce::canonicalize consistently at remaining path-canonicalization sites
content.description: Only callisto-vcs/src/lib.rs:200 uses dunce::canonicalize (strips Windows \\?\ extended-length prefixes); crates/callisto-graph/src/locate/root.rs:7, locate/ignore_walk.rs:24, callisto-cli/src/workspace.rs:13 (load_workspace), and callisto-cli/src/commands/pre.rs:124 all call raw std::path::Path::canonicalize(). Add dunce as a dependency to callisto-graph/callisto-cli and replace all four raw calls.

content.subject: Move tempfile to dev-dependencies in callisto-changelog
content.description: crates/callisto-changelog/Cargo.toml declares tempfile under [dependencies] but every usage (write.rs:198,239,283,318,352) is inside #[cfg(test)]. Move to [dev-dependencies].

content.subject: Remove unused serde_yaml dependency and dead GraphError::ParseYaml variant
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/Cargo.toml declares serde_yaml with zero usages anywhere in src; GraphError::ParseYaml (error.rs:289) is never constructed. Remove both, or wire up real YAML parsing (e.g. for pnpm-workspace.yaml, referenced but never parsed) with a maintained replacement if that's actually wanted — confirm with the user which before implementing.

content.subject: Use semver crate in check_git_version instead of hand-rolled parsing
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/exec.rs check_git_version (93-122) hand-splits on '.' with .unwrap_or(0) fallbacks that silently coerce non-numeric segments to 0, instead of using semver::VersionReq (already a workspace dep, already imported by callisto_model::version in the same crate). Parse REQUIRED_GIT itself via semver to derive the comparison floor; surface a distinct diagnostic on genuine parse failure instead of silently defaulting to zero.

content.subject: Centralize re-pinned workspace dependencies
content.description: tempfile (5 crates), miette (callisto-cli), petgraph (callisto-graph) re-declare versions locally instead of {workspace = true}. proptest (4 crates) and schemars (3 crates) are used identically across multiple crates but never centralized in [workspace.dependencies] at all. Convert re-pinned deps to workspace=true; add proptest/schemars to [workspace.dependencies].

content.subject: Document callisto matrix in docs/00-design.md and docs/01-spec.md
content.description: docs/00-design.md has zero mentions of matrix/PlatformTarget/MatrixReport/napi-maturin auto-discovery. docs/01-spec.md has exactly one incidental reference to "§SPEC-004" with no actual SPEC-004 section, despite code doc comments referencing AC-001 through AC-018. Add a full crate-letter-numbered section to docs/01-spec.md (schema, platform-triple table, acceptance criteria) and a narrative section to docs/00-design.md.

content.subject: Add callisto-vcs to crate architecture docs
content.description: docs/01-spec.md says "Nine crates" (there are ten); the crate-letter legend (lines 55-58) has no letter for callisto-vcs; the ASCII dependency diagram (70-90) has no callisto-vcs box and a misaligned callisto-changelog row. callisto-vcs is only mentioned in a late appendix (§13.6). Add callisto-vcs to the crate-letter legend, give it a full spec section matching the other nine crates, fix the diagram, correct "nine" to "ten."

content.subject: Doc-comment DiagnosticCode enum and its variants
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/diagnostic.rs DiagnosticCode enum (91-108, now 20 variants) has zero doc comments on the enum or any variant — this is the discriminator serialized into every JSON diagnostic and consumed by CI tooling. Doc-comment each variant with its trigger condition and default severity, mirroring the density already present on RegistryError's variants.

content.subject: Doc-comment solve_cascade, RateLimitPolicy, TimeProvider, REQUIRED_GIT, RuntimeEcosystem
content.description: Five undocumented public API surfaces on freshly-touched or architecturally central code, each inconsistent with well-documented siblings in the same file: solve_cascade (crates/callisto-graph/src/cascade.rs:167, the ~200-line worklist algorithm at the heart of the largest crate), RateLimitPolicy/TimeProvider (crates/callisto-model/src/registry.rs:79-86, the retry/backoff extension points), REQUIRED_GIT (crates/callisto-model/src/exec.rs:4), RuntimeEcosystem (crates/callisto-model/src/matrix.rs:84-89). Bring doc-comment density in line with each file's existing documented neighbors.

content.subject: Fix ARCHITECTURE.md factual errors
content.description: ARCHITECTURE.md:123 claims callisto-changelog depends on pulldown-cmark (it doesn't — the renderer builds Markdown by hand). ARCHITECTURE.md's Layer1 mermaid subgraph (90-105) is titled "Permissive" but contains two AGPL-licensed crates (callisto-conventional, callisto-changelog), contradicting the licensing table two lines below and CLAUDE.md invariant #4's narrower "Layer 1" scope. Correct the dependency claim; rename the subgraph to avoid the permissiveness claim and reconcile "Layer 1" terminology between the two docs.

content.subject: Fix git ref-name leading-hyphen injection
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/tag.rs is_valid_git_ref_name has no leading-hyphen check; a tag-template like "-f{version}" renders to "-f1.0.0" which git interprets as a flag. Add the check, and as defense-in-depth insert "--" before the ref-name arg in ShellGit::create_tag/create_floating_major (crates/callisto-vcs/src/shell.rs).

content.subject: Redact secrets from subprocess stderr before embedding in reports/logs
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish_client.rs embeds raw subprocess stderr verbatim into RegistryError/PublishReport JSON and CI logs with zero scrubbing. Add a redaction pass (strip URL userinfo, known token env-var values) before wrapping stderr into any error/report type.

content.subject: Bound subprocess stdout/stderr buffer size
content.description: crates/callisto-cli/src/runner.rs's run/run_with_timeout capture stdout/stderr with no byte cap (only the 300s wall-clock timeout bounds anything). Cap accumulated output at a fixed size with a "[output truncated]" marker while still draining the pipe to avoid reintroducing the deadlock commit 6e16212 fixed.

content.subject: Fix Cargo dependency-spec silent no-op for unrecognized value shapes
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/cargo.rs: CargoToml::update_dependency_spec (~347-374) and WorkspaceCargoResolver::write_dependency (~684-699) both fall through to Ok(()) with zero mutation when a dependency TOML value is neither string nor table. Add a trailing else/error branch to both, same pattern in both places.

content.subject: Fix bare 401/403 substring auth-failure misclassification
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish_client.rs detect_auth_failure (~697-709) does bare .contains("401")/.contains("403") with no word-boundary guard, unlike the adjacent detect_rate_limit's guard against bare "429". A byte count like "140312" would misclassify as AuthFailed. Add the same contextual co-occurrence guard.

content.subject: Fix detect_npm_role/role_to_triple ABI mismatch for Linux napi targets
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/walk.rs detect_npm_role (~454) always sets abi: None, but napi.rs::role_to_triple's Linux match arms all require Some("gnu")/Some("musl")/Some("gnueabihf") — a real disk-discovered Linux napi package can never round-trip. Give detect_npm_role access to ABI inference (napi-rs package-name suffix convention) or make role_to_triple treat abi:None as a wildcard on Linux.

content.subject: Add PEP 503 normalization to Python dependency-name matching
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/python.rs update_dependency_spec (line 330) and update_optional_dependencies (line 458) only case-fold names (.eq_ignore_ascii_case), not PEP 503 separator equivalence (-/_/. interchangeable). Apply the same PEP 503 normalization already used for the PyPI wheel-filename glob in publish_client.rs's pypi_publish.

content.subject: Dedupe platform triples in matrix.rs
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs assemble_platform_target_group (306-338) doesn't dedupe triples read from napi.targets/[tool.maturin].targets before building PlatformTargets — a copy-paste duplicate in a hand-maintained manifest produces duplicate CI matrix jobs. Dedupe before construction; optionally warn on a dropped duplicate.

content.subject: Add PackageId::resolve_unique() safe API and migrate remaining .find()-over-matches() site
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/identity.rs PackageId::matches() returns a bare bool for an ambiguity-prone operation; commit 84e3a73 fixed 2 call sites by hand (aggregate.rs, status.rs) but never added a safe API, so the pattern isn't enforced. Add a resolve_unique() method encapsulating collect-and-error, migrate the two already-fixed call sites to use it, and migrate crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs's resolve_package_config (still first-match .find()) if that call site's semantics genuinely need uniqueness (verify it's not intentionally most-specific-wins first).

content.subject: Convert PreMajorInferencePolicy to a proper 3-state enum
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs PreMajorInferencePolicy (135-146) models a closed 3-state policy as two independent public bools, permitting an unreachable-via-parser 4th combination via plain struct literal. Replace with enum PreMajorInferencePolicy { Off, Conservative, ConservativeFeat }, update parse_pre_major_policy and all call sites.

content.subject: Split PackageIdParseError::PathTraversal from leading-hyphen error
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/identity.rs reuses PackageIdParseError::PathTraversal (message "contains path traversal `..`") for the unrelated leading-hyphen check (lines 31-32, 46-47, 64-65, 226-227) even when the input has no "..". Add a dedicated LeadingHyphen variant with an accurate message; add message-content assertions to the existing test.

content.subject: Model PublishTarget::Npm access as a 3-state enum instead of bool
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/npm.rs PublishTarget::Npm.restricted: bool collapses absent/public/restricted npm access into two states, forcing crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs (~224) to re-derive scope via starts_with('@') string-sniffing. Model as access: Option<NpmAccess> reusing the existing NpmAccess enum.

content.subject: Resolve IdentityResolver duplication — delete if dead, else route through Manifest trait
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/identity.rs IdentityResolver::resolve hand-parses manifests directly instead of using callisto-manifests' Manifest::package_name(). Verify (walk.rs:58-63 suggests it may no longer be called at all, having been replaced by locator-resolved proj.id) whether IdentityResolver has any live callers; if dead, remove it; if live, route it through the Manifest trait's open()/.package_name() instead of duplicating the parsing.

content.subject: Add probe/quiet mode to CommandRunner for existence-check subprocess calls
content.description: crates/callisto-cli/src/runner.rs unconditionally streams subprocess stderr live with no "internal probe" signal. SubprocessRegistryClient::npm_is_published's npm view existence check streams raw npm stderr live even on the expected 404-shaped "not published yet" result, looking like a failure during every first-time publish. Add a run_quiet/probe variant to CommandRunner and use it for is_published-style calls; reserve live streaming for the actual mutating publish() call.

content.subject: Resolve Layer 1 AGPL dev-dependency on callisto-fixtures
content.description: crates/callisto-model/Cargo.toml and crates/callisto-format/Cargo.toml both dev-depend on AGPL-licensed callisto-fixtures, contradicting CLAUDE.md invariant #4's "Layer 1 must never depend on AGPL crates" (no dev-dependency carve-out stated). Either document the dev-only exception explicitly in ARCHITECTURE.md, or extract the shared test doubles into a small MIT/Apache dev-fixtures crate — decide which with the user before implementing.

content.subject: Consolidate plan_publish to one shared GitAccess + add fallback test
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs still performs 2 independent GitAccess::discover calls (head_sha at line 111, plus one implicit inside ws.tags()->TagIndex::build) instead of 1 shared instance the way status() now does it (commit 7634e5f). Consolidate into one shared GitAccess, and add a dedicated publish_tests.rs test proving plan.releases populates correctly via the shell fallback when gix is unavailable (currently only the total-git-failure path is tested for publish).

content.subject: Eliminate matrix.rs's double manifest parse per package
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs assemble_platform_target_group (63-246) and assemble_runtime_versions (368-396) each independently read+parse the same package.json/pyproject.toml per package. Read/parse each manifest once per package into a shared value; have both extraction paths consult it.

content.subject: Reuse TagIndex's tag list in create_tags instead of re-querying git
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/tag.rs create_tags_with_options (line 79) calls git.list_tags per release as an existence check even though TagIndex::build already fetched the full tag list once via fetch_all_tags. Expose the raw tag list from TagIndex and check existence against that in-memory set first.

content.subject: Fix workspace_relative to use camino/path-slash instead of hand-rolled parsing
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/path.rs workspace_relative() hand-rolls path normalization with .replace('\\', "/") which is byte-incorrect on Unix (treats a literal backslash, a legal filename byte, as a separator). camino and path-slash are both already declared workspace dependencies with zero usages anywhere. Use camino::Utf8PathBuf::from_path_buf() and path_slash::PathExt::to_slash(), or remove the unused deps if the hand-rolled logic turns out intentional (unlikely given the confirmed Unix bug).

content.subject: Apply dunce::canonicalize consistently at remaining path-canonicalization sites
content.description: Only callisto-vcs/src/lib.rs:200 uses dunce::canonicalize (strips Windows \\?\ extended-length prefixes); crates/callisto-graph/src/locate/root.rs:7, locate/ignore_walk.rs:24, callisto-cli/src/workspace.rs:13 (load_workspace), and callisto-cli/src/commands/pre.rs:124 all call raw std::path::Path::canonicalize(). Add dunce as a dependency to callisto-graph/callisto-cli and replace all four raw calls.

content.subject: Move tempfile to dev-dependencies in callisto-changelog
content.description: crates/callisto-changelog/Cargo.toml declares tempfile under [dependencies] but every usage (write.rs:198,239,283,318,352) is inside #[cfg(test)]. Move to [dev-dependencies].

content.subject: Remove unused serde_yaml dependency and dead GraphError::ParseYaml variant
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/Cargo.toml declares serde_yaml with zero usages anywhere in src; GraphError::ParseYaml (error.rs:289) is never constructed. Remove both, or wire up real YAML parsing (e.g. for pnpm-workspace.yaml, referenced but never parsed) with a maintained replacement if that's actually wanted — confirm with the user which before implementing.

content.subject: Use semver crate in check_git_version instead of hand-rolled parsing
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/exec.rs check_git_version (93-122) hand-splits on '.' with .unwrap_or(0) fallbacks that silently coerce non-numeric segments to 0, instead of using semver::VersionReq (already a workspace dep, already imported by callisto_model::version in the same crate). Parse REQUIRED_GIT itself via semver to derive the comparison floor; surface a distinct diagnostic on genuine parse failure instead of silently defaulting to zero.

content.subject: Centralize re-pinned workspace dependencies
content.description: tempfile (5 crates), miette (callisto-cli), petgraph (callisto-graph) re-declare versions locally instead of {workspace = true}. proptest (4 crates) and schemars (3 crates) are used identically across multiple crates but never centralized in [workspace.dependencies] at all. Convert re-pinned deps to workspace=true; add proptest/schemars to [workspace.dependencies].

content.subject: Document callisto matrix in docs/00-design.md and docs/01-spec.md
content.description: docs/00-design.md has zero mentions of matrix/PlatformTarget/MatrixReport/napi-maturin auto-discovery. docs/01-spec.md has exactly one incidental reference to "§SPEC-004" with no actual SPEC-004 section, despite code doc comments referencing AC-001 through AC-018. Add a full crate-letter-numbered section to docs/01-spec.md (schema, platform-triple table, acceptance criteria) and a narrative section to docs/00-design.md.

content.subject: Add callisto-vcs to crate architecture docs
content.description: docs/01-spec.md says "Nine crates" (there are ten); the crate-letter legend (lines 55-58) has no letter for callisto-vcs; the ASCII dependency diagram (70-90) has no callisto-vcs box and a misaligned callisto-changelog row. callisto-vcs is only mentioned in a late appendix (§13.6). Add callisto-vcs to the crate-letter legend, give it a full spec section matching the other nine crates, fix the diagram, correct "nine" to "ten."

content.subject: Doc-comment DiagnosticCode enum and its variants
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/diagnostic.rs DiagnosticCode enum (91-108, now 20 variants) has zero doc comments on the enum or any variant — this is the discriminator serialized into every JSON diagnostic and consumed by CI tooling. content.subject: Fix git ref-name leading-hyphen injection
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/tag.rs is_valid_git_ref_name has no leading-hyphen check; a tag-template like "-f{version}" renders to "-f1.0.0" which git interprets as a flag. Add the check, and as defense-in-depth insert "--" before the ref-name arg in ShellGit::create_tag/create_floating_major (crates/callisto-vcs/src/shell.rs).

content.subject: Redact secrets from subprocess stderr before embedding in reports/logs
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish_client.rs embeds raw subprocess stderr verbatim into RegistryError/PublishReport JSON and CI logs with zero scrubbing. Add a redaction pass (strip URL userinfo, known token env-var values) before wrapping stderr into any error/report type.

content.subject: Bound subprocess stdout/stderr buffer size
content.description: crates/callisto-cli/src/runner.rs's run/run_with_timeout capture stdout/stderr with no byte cap (only the 300s wall-clock timeout bounds anything). Cap accumulated output at a fixed size with a "[output truncated]" marker while still draining the pipe to avoid reintroducing the deadlock commit 6e16212 fixed.

content.subject: Fix Cargo dependency-spec silent no-op for unrecognized value shapes
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/cargo.rs: CargoToml::update_dependency_spec (~347-374) and WorkspaceCargoResolver::write_dependency (~684-699) both fall through to Ok(()) with zero mutation when a dependency TOML value is neither string nor table. Add a trailing else/error branch to both, same pattern in both places.

content.subject: Fix bare 401/403 substring auth-failure misclassification
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish_client.rs detect_auth_failure (~697-709) does bare .contains("401")/.contains("403") with no word-boundary guard, unlike the adjacent detect_rate_limit's guard against bare "429". A byte count like "140312" would misclassify as AuthFailed. Add the same contextual co-occurrence guard.

content.subject: Fix detect_npm_role/role_to_triple ABI mismatch for Linux napi targets
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/walk.rs detect_npm_role (~454) always sets abi: None, but napi.rs::role_to_triple's Linux match arms all require Some("gnu")/Some("musl")/Some("gnueabihf") — a real disk-discovered Linux napi package can never round-trip. Give detect_npm_role access to ABI inference (napi-rs package-name suffix convention) or make role_to_triple treat abi:None as a wildcard on Linux.

content.subject: Add PEP 503 normalization to Python dependency-name matching
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/python.rs update_dependency_spec (line 330) and update_optional_dependencies (line 458) only case-fold names (.eq_ignore_ascii_case), not PEP 503 separator equivalence (-/_/. interchangeable). Apply the same PEP 503 normalization already used for the PyPI wheel-filename glob in publish_client.rs's pypi_publish.

content.subject: Dedupe platform triples in matrix.rs
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs assemble_platform_target_group (306-338) doesn't dedupe triples read from napi.targets/[tool.maturin].targets before building PlatformTargets — a copy-paste duplicate in a hand-maintained manifest produces duplicate CI matrix jobs. Dedupe before construction; optionally warn on a dropped duplicate.

content.subject: Add PackageId::resolve_unique() safe API and migrate remaining .find()-over-matches() site
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/identity.rs PackageId::matches() returns a bare bool for an ambiguity-prone operation; commit 84e3a73 fixed 2 call sites by hand (aggregate.rs, status.rs) but never added a safe API, so the pattern isn't enforced. Add a resolve_unique() method encapsulating collect-and-error, migrate the two already-fixed call sites to use it, and migrate crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs's resolve_package_config (still first-match .find()) if that call site's semantics genuinely need uniqueness (verify it's not intentionally most-specific-wins first).

content.subject: Convert PreMajorInferencePolicy to a proper 3-state enum
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs PreMajorInferencePolicy (135-146) models a closed 3-state policy as two independent public bools, permitting an unreachable-via-parser 4th combination via plain struct literal. Replace with enum PreMajorInferencePolicy { Off, Conservative, ConservativeFeat }, update parse_pre_major_policy and all call sites.

content.subject: Split PackageIdParseError::PathTraversal from leading-hyphen error
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/identity.rs reuses PackageIdParseError::PathTraversal (message "contains path traversal `..`") for the unrelated leading-hyphen check (lines 31-32, 46-47, 64-65, 226-227) even when the input has no "..". Add a dedicated LeadingHyphen variant with an accurate message; add message-content assertions to the existing test.

content.subject: Model PublishTarget::Npm access as a 3-state enum instead of bool
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/npm.rs PublishTarget::Npm.restricted: bool collapses absent/public/restricted npm access into two states, forcing crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs (~224) to re-derive scope via starts_with('@') string-sniffing. Model as access: Option<NpmAccess> reusing the existing NpmAccess enum.

content.subject: Resolve IdentityResolver duplication — delete if dead, else route through Manifest trait
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/identity.rs IdentityResolver::resolve hand-parses manifests directly instead of using callisto-manifests' Manifest::package_name(). Verify (walk.rs:58-63 suggests it may no longer be called at all, having been replaced by locator-resolved proj.id) whether IdentityResolver has any live callers; if dead, remove it; if live, route it through the Manifest trait's open()/.package_name() instead of duplicating the parsing.

content.subject: Add probe/quiet mode to CommandRunner for existence-check subprocess calls
content.description: crates/callisto-cli/src/runner.rs unconditionally streams subprocess stderr live with no "internal probe" signal. SubprocessRegistryClient::npm_is_published's npm view existence check streams raw npm stderr live even on the expected 404-shaped "not published yet" result, looking like a failure during every first-time publish. Add a run_quiet/probe variant to CommandRunner and use it for is_published-style calls; reserve live streaming for the actual mutating publish() call.

content.subject: Resolve Layer 1 AGPL dev-dependency on callisto-fixtures
content.description: crates/callisto-model/Cargo.toml and crates/callisto-format/Cargo.toml both dev-depend on AGPL-licensed callisto-fixtures, contradicting CLAUDE.md invariant #4's "Layer 1 must never depend on AGPL crates" (no dev-dependency carve-out stated). content.subject: Consolidate plan_publish to one shared GitAccess + add fallback test
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs still performs 2 independent GitAccess::discover calls (head_sha at line 111, plus one implicit inside ws.tags()->TagIndex::build) instead of 1 shared instance the way status() now does it (commit 7634e5f). content.subject: Eliminate matrix.rs's double manifest parse per package
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs assemble_platform_target_group (63-246) and assemble_runtime_versions (368-396) each independently read+parse the same package.json/pyproject.toml per package. content.subject: Reuse TagIndex's tag list in create_tags instead of re-querying git
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/tag.rs create_tags_with_options (line 79) calls git.list_tags per release as an existence check even though TagIndex::build already fetched the full tag list once via fetch_all_tags. content.subject: Fix workspace_relative to use camino/path-slash instead of hand-rolled parsing
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/path.rs workspace_relative() hand-rolls path normalization with .replace('\\', "/") which is byte-incorrect on Unix (treats a literal backslash, a legal filename byte, as a separator). camino and path-slash are both already declared workspace dependencies with zero usages anywhere.
