content.subject: Fix git ref-name leading-hyphen injection
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/tag.rs is_valid_git_ref_name has no leading-hyphen check; a tag-template like "-f{version}" renders to "-f1.0.0" which git interprets as a flag. Add the check, and as defense-in-depth insert "--" before the ref-name arg in ShellGit::create_tag/create_floating_major (crates/callisto-vcs/src/shell.rs).

content.subject: Redact secrets from subprocess stderr before embedding in reports/logs
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish_client.rs embeds raw subprocess stderr verbatim into RegistryError/PublishReport JSON and CI logs with zero scrubbing. Add a redaction pass (strip URL userinfo, known token env-var values) before wrapping stderr into any error/report type.

content.subject: Bound subprocess stdout/stderr buffer size
content.description: crates/callisto-cli/src/runner.rs's run/run_with_timeout capture stdout/stderr with no byte cap (only the 300s wall-clock timeout bounds anything). Cap accumulated output at a fixed size with a "[output truncated]" marker while still draining the pipe to avoid reintroducing the deadlock commit 6e16212 fixed.

content.subject: Fix Cargo dependency-spec silent no-op for unrecognized value shapes
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/cargo.rs: CargoToml::update_dependency_spec (~347-374) and WorkspaceCargoResolver::write_dependency (~684-699) both fall through to Ok(()) with zero mutation when a dependency TOML value is neither string nor table. Add a trailing else/error branch to both, same pattern in both places.

content.subject: Fix bare 401/403 substring auth-failure misclassification
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish_client.rs detect_auth_failure (~697-709) does bare .contains("401")/.contains("403") with no word-boundary guard, unlike the adjacent detect_rate_limit's guard against bare "429". A byte count like "140312" would misclassify as AuthFailed. Add the same contextual co-occurrence guard.

content.subject: Fix detect_npm_role/role_to_triple ABI mismatch for Linux napi targets
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/walk.rs detect_npm_role (~454) always sets abi: None, but napi.rs::role_to_triple's Linux match arms all require Some("gnu")/Some("musl")/Some("gnueabihf") — a real disk-discovered Linux napi package can never round-trip. Give detect_npm_role access to ABI inference (napi-rs package-name suffix convention) or make role_to_triple treat abi:None as a wildcard on Linux.

content.subject: Add PEP 503 normalization to Python dependency-name matching
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/python.rs update_dependency_spec (line 330) and update_optional_dependencies (line 458) only case-fold names (.eq_ignore_ascii_case), not PEP 503 separator equivalence (-/_/. interchangeable). Apply the same PEP 503 normalization already used for the PyPI wheel-filename glob in publish_client.rs's pypi_publish.

content.subject: Dedupe platform triples in matrix.rs
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs assemble_platform_target_group (306-338) doesn't dedupe triples read from napi.targets/[tool.maturin].targets before building PlatformTargets — a copy-paste duplicate in a hand-maintained manifest produces duplicate CI matrix jobs. Dedupe before construction; optionally warn on a dropped duplicate.

content.subject: Add PackageId::resolve_unique() safe API and migrate remaining .find()-over-matches() site
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/identity.rs PackageId::matches() returns a bare bool for an ambiguity-prone operation; commit 84e3a73 fixed 2 call sites by hand (aggregate.rs, status.rs) but never added a safe API, so the pattern isn't enforced. Add a resolve_unique() method encapsulating collect-and-error, migrate the two already-fixed call sites to use it, and migrate crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs's resolve_package_config (still first-match .find()) if that call site's semantics genuinely need uniqueness (verify it's not intentionally most-specific-wins first).

content.subject: Convert PreMajorInferencePolicy to a proper 3-state enum
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs PreMajorInferencePolicy (135-146) models a closed 3-state policy as two independent public bools, permitting an unreachable-via-parser 4th combination via plain struct literal. Replace with enum PreMajorInferencePolicy { Off, Conservative, ConservativeFeat }, update parse_pre_major_policy and all call sites.

content.subject: Split PackageIdParseError::PathTraversal from leading-hyphen error
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/identity.rs reuses PackageIdParseError::PathTraversal (message "contains path traversal `..`") for the unrelated leading-hyphen check (lines 31-32, 46-47, 64-65, 226-227) even when the input has no "..". Add a dedicated LeadingHyphen variant with an accurate message; add message-content assertions to the existing test.

content.subject: Model PublishTarget::Npm access as a 3-state enum instead of bool
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/npm.rs PublishTarget::Npm.restricted: bool collapses absent/public/restricted npm access into two states, forcing crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs (~224) to re-derive scope via starts_with('@') string-sniffing. Model as access: Option<NpmAccess> reusing the existing NpmAccess enum.

content.subject: Resolve IdentityResolver duplication — delete if dead, else route through Manifest trait
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/identity.rs IdentityResolver::resolve hand-parses manifests directly instead of using callisto-manifests' Manifest::package_name(). Verify (walk.rs:58-63 suggests it may no longer be called at all, having been replaced by locator-resolved proj.id) whether IdentityResolver has any live callers; if dead, remove it; if live, route it through the Manifest trait's open()/.package_name() instead of duplicating the parsing.

content.subject: Add probe/quiet mode to CommandRunner for existence-check subprocess calls
content.description: crates/callisto-cli/src/runner.rs unconditionally streams subprocess stderr live with no "internal probe" signal. SubprocessRegistryClient::npm_is_published's npm view existence check streams raw npm stderr live even on the expected 404-shaped "not published yet" result, looking like a failure during every first-time publish. Add a run_quiet/probe variant to CommandRunner and use it for is_published-style calls; reserve live streaming for the actual mutating publish() call.

content.subject: Resolve Layer 1 AGPL dev-dependency on callisto-fixtures
content.description: crates/callisto-model/Cargo.toml and crates/callisto-format/Cargo.toml both dev-depend on AGPL-licensed callisto-fixtures, contradicting CLAUDE.md invariant #4's "Layer 1 must never depend on AGPL crates" (no dev-dependency carve-out stated). Either document the dev-only exception explicitly in ARCHITECTURE.md, or extract the shared test doubles into a small MIT/Apache dev-fixtures crate — decide which with the user before implementing.

content.subject: Consolidate plan_publish to one shared GitAccess + add fallback test
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs still performs 2 independent GitAccess::discover calls (head_sha at line 111, plus one implicit inside ws.tags()->TagIndex::build) instead of 1 shared instance the way status() now does it (commit 7634e5f). Consolidate into one shared GitAccess, and add a dedicated publish_tests.rs test proving plan.releases populates correctly via the shell fallback when gix is unavailable (currently only the total-git-failure path is tested for publish).

content.subject: Eliminate matrix.rs's double manifest parse per package
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs assemble_platform_target_group (63-246) and assemble_runtime_versions (368-396) each independently read+parse the same package.json/pyproject.toml per package. Read/parse each manifest once per package into a shared value; have both extraction paths consult it.

content.subject: Reuse TagIndex's tag list in create_tags instead of re-querying git
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/tag.rs create_tags_with_options (line 79) calls git.list_tags per release as an existence check even though TagIndex::build already fetched the full tag list once via fetch_all_tags. Expose the raw tag list from TagIndex and check existence against that in-memory set first.

content.subject: Fix workspace_relative to use camino/path-slash instead of hand-rolled parsing
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/path.rs workspace_relative() hand-rolls path normalization with .replace('\\', "/") which is byte-incorrect on Unix (treats a literal backslash, a legal filename byte, as a separator). camino and path-slash are both already declared workspace dependencies with zero usages anywhere. Use camino::Utf8PathBuf::from_path_buf() and path_slash::PathExt::to_slash(), or remove the unused deps if the hand-rolled logic turns out intentional (unlikely given the confirmed Unix bug).

content.subject: Apply dunce::canonicalize consistently at remaining path-canonicalization sites
content.description: Only callisto-vcs/src/lib.rs:200 uses dunce::canonicalize (strips Windows \\?\ extended-length prefixes); crates/callisto-graph/src/locate/root.rs:7, locate/ignore_walk.rs:24, callisto-cli/src/workspace.rs:13 (load_workspace), and callisto-cli/src/commands/pre.rs:124 all call raw std::path::Path::canonicalize(). Add dunce as a dependency to callisto-graph/callisto-cli and replace all four raw calls.

content.subject: Move tempfile to dev-dependencies in callisto-changelog
content.description: crates/callisto-changelog/Cargo.toml declares tempfile under [dependencies] but every usage (write.rs:198,239,283,318,352) is inside #[cfg(test)]. Move to [dev-dependencies].

content.subject: Remove unused serde_yaml dependency and dead GraphError::ParseYaml variant
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/Cargo.toml declares serde_yaml with zero usages anywhere in src; GraphError::ParseYaml (error.rs:289) is never constructed. Remove both, or wire up real YAML parsing (e.g. for pnpm-workspace.yaml, referenced but never parsed) with a maintained replacement if that's actually wanted — confirm with the user which before implementing.

content.subject: Use semver crate in check_git_version instead of hand-rolled parsing
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/exec.rs check_git_version (93-122) hand-splits on '.' with .unwrap_or(0) fallbacks that silently coerce non-numeric segments to 0, instead of using semver::VersionReq (already a workspace dep, already imported by callisto_model::version in the same crate). Parse REQUIRED_GIT itself via semver to derive the comparison floor; surface a distinct diagnostic on genuine parse failure instead of silently defaulting to zero.

content.subject: Centralize re-pinned workspace dependencies
content.description: tempfile (5 crates), miette (callisto-cli), petgraph (callisto-graph) re-declare versions locally instead of {workspace = true}. proptest (4 crates) and schemars (3 crates) are used identically across multiple crates but never centralized in [workspace.dependencies] at all. Convert re-pinned deps to workspace=true; add proptest/schemars to [workspace.dependencies].

content.subject: Document callisto matrix in docs/00-design.md and docs/01-spec.md
content.description: docs/00-design.md has zero mentions of matrix/PlatformTarget/MatrixReport/napi-maturin auto-discovery. docs/01-spec.md has exactly one incidental reference to "§SPEC-004" with no actual SPEC-004 section, despite code doc comments referencing AC-001 through AC-018. Add a full crate-letter-numbered section to docs/01-spec.md (schema, platform-triple table, acceptance criteria) and a narrative section to docs/00-design.md.

content.subject: Add callisto-vcs to crate architecture docs
content.description: docs/01-spec.md says "Nine crates" (there are ten); the crate-letter legend (lines 55-58) has no letter for callisto-vcs; the ASCII dependency diagram (70-90) has no callisto-vcs box and a misaligned callisto-changelog row. callisto-vcs is only mentioned in a late appendix (§13.6). Add callisto-vcs to the crate-letter legend, give it a full spec section matching the other nine crates, fix the diagram, correct "nine" to "ten."

content.subject: Doc-comment DiagnosticCode enum and its variants
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/diagnostic.rs DiagnosticCode enum (91-108, now 20 variants) has zero doc comments on the enum or any variant — this is the discriminator serialized into every JSON diagnostic and consumed by CI tooling. **Not dead code.** `IdentityResolver` is constructed and called from a genuine production entry point.

All references to `IdentityResolver` in the live tree:

- `crates/callisto-graph/src/identity.rs:8` — struct definition
- `crates/callisto-graph/src/identity.rs:12-17` — `impl IdentityResolver::new`

- `crates/callisto-graph/src/walk.rs:59-63` — **comment only**, no construction/call. The comment explicitly documents that `ManifestWalkResolver::build` deliberately avoids `IdentityResolver::resolve` in favor of locator-resolved IDs, because the resolver "historically had no `Ecosystem::Pypi` arm and would crash for Python projects."
- `crates/callisto-graph/tests/ecosystem_bugs_test.rs:4,49` — **doc-comment/prose only**, no construction/call.
- `crates/callisto-moon/src/locator.rs:5` — `use callisto_graph::identity::IdentityResolver;`
- `crates/callisto-moon/src/locator.rs:15` — field `identity: IdentityResolver` on `MoonProjectLocator`
- `crates/callisto-moon/src/locator.rs:22` — **construction**: `IdentityResolver::new(&workspace_root)...` inside `MoonProjectLocator::new`

- `execute_extension` (line 145) → `MoonProjectLocator::new` at line 155
- `initialize_extension` (line 245) → `MoonProjectLocator::new` at line 263

These are the actual WASM PDK plugin entry points (`execute_extension`/`initialize_extension`), built into the shipped `callisto-moon.wasm` artifact under the `pdk` feature (per the crate's own Cargo.toml comments explaining the deliberate `cdylib` build setup for exactly this purpose). Nothing else in the workspace depends on `callisto-moon` (grep for `callisto-moon`/`callisto_moon` across all `Cargo.toml`/`.rs` files turns up only the crate's own files), but within `callisto-moon` itself the path from plugin entry point → `IdentityResolver::resolve` is live and unconditional (not behind a dead branch).

Separately, `callisto-model/src/identity.rs:158-163` defines an unrelated `PackageIdentityResolver` trait — different type, not `IdentityResolver`, matched only by substring.

**Conclusion**: `IdentityResolver` is reachable and actively used from production code (`callisto-moon`'s plugin extension handlers), not unreachable/dead. Note `callisto-graph`'s own primary manifest-walk path (`walk.rs`) deliberately bypasses it — the duplication with `Manifest::package_name()` (confirmed to exist at `crates/callisto-manifests/src/lib.rs:28`, implemented in `npm.rs:221`, `cargo.rs:155`, `python.rs:102`) is real, but the fix is "route through Manifest trait," not "delete as dead code," since `callisto-moon` still depends on it.

- **`pnpm-workspace.yaml` handling**: it is checked only for **existence**, never read or parsed. `crates/callisto-graph/src/locate/root.rs:46-48`: `if dir.join("pnpm-workspace.yaml").exists() { return true; }` inside `is_workspace_root`. Note: `callisto-fixtures/Cargo.toml` has no `[features]` table at all, so the `default-features = false` on this declaration is a no-op today.
- **`crates/callisto-fixtures/Cargo.toml:5`**: `license = "AGPL-3.0-only"` — confirmed still AGPL-3.0-only. Its own `[dependencies]` pulls in `callisto-model` (path dep) — i.e., `callisto-model` dev-depends on a crate that depends back on `callisto-model` itself (allowed in Cargo since dev-deps don't participate in the crate's own compile graph).

Both crates have no separate `tests/` integration-test directories (only inline `#[cfg(test)]` modules in `src/`), so this covers all test code in both crates.

**Conclusion**: as of HEAD, `callisto-fixtures` is declared as a dev-dependency in both `callisto-model` and `callisto-format` but is **completely unused** by either crate's test code — not "a small easily-extractable set of test doubles," but literally zero references. # Remaining backlog: tasks #9–#31 (23 items)

## Context

This session ran a full re-verification of a 2026-08-12 workspace audit, confirmed which findings were already fixed and which weren't, and built a priority-ordered 31-item backlog (harness tasks #1–#31). Tasks #1–#8 (security + correctness tiers) are shipped — 8 commits, each independently reviewed, two real bugs caught and fixed pre-commit, two new findings discovered along the way and tracked (#30, #31). This plan covers the remaining 23 items: #9–29 (originally-scoped domain-modeling/architecture/performance/dependency-hygiene/docs work) plus #30–31 (the two new findings).

Process for every item below, unchanged from #1–#8: red test confirming the bug/gap → minimal fix → green → independent read-only review agent → fix anything it finds → full crate test suite + clippy + `cargo fmt` → commit. No task starts until the previous one is committed. This is not the full canon→vector→lambda pipeline — these are targeted, well-scoped point fixes, not architectural specs.

**One item required real investigation before it could be planned** (task #13, `IdentityResolver`) — see below; the other 22 are already fully specified from this session's verification work and need no further design.

---

## Phase A — Domain modeling / type safety (#9–12)

Straightforward, individually TDD'd and committed. No open design questions.

- **#9 — `PackageId::resolve_unique()` safe API.** Add a method to `callisto-model/src/identity.rs` encapsulating the collect-and-error pattern commit `84e3a73` already hand-inlined at 2 call sites (`aggregate.rs`, `status.rs`). Migrate those 2 sites to call it. Check `config/resolve.rs`'s `resolve_package_config` (still first-match `.find()`) — verify whether its "most-specific-wins" semantics are genuinely different from identity resolution (config override lookup vs. package identity) before deciding whether to migrate it too; don't force a migration that changes real behavior.
- **#10 — `PreMajorInferencePolicy` → 3-state enum.** Replace the two-bool struct in `config/resolve.rs` with `enum { Off, Conservative, ConservativeFeat }`. Update `parse_pre_major_policy` and all call sites.
- **#11 — Split `PackageIdParseError::PathTraversal` from leading-hyphen.** Add a dedicated variant with an accurate message in `callisto-model/src/identity.rs`; update the 4 cited call sites and add message-content assertions.
- **#12 — `PublishTarget::Npm.restricted: bool` → 3-state.** Model `access: Option<NpmAccess>` (reusing the existing `NpmAccess` enum) instead of a bool; update `npm.rs` and the `starts_with('@')`-sniffing call site in `commands/publish.rs`.

## Phase B — Architecture (#13–15)

- **#13 — `IdentityResolver` duplication.** *(Investigated this session — see below, scope revised from the original task text.)*
- **#14 — Probe/quiet mode for `CommandRunner`.** Add a `run_quiet`/probe variant so `SubprocessRegistryClient::npm_is_published`'s existence check doesn't stream raw npm stderr live on the expected 404 case.
- **#15 — AGPL fixtures dev-dependency.** *(Investigated this session — see below, resolved.)*

### #13 in detail — `IdentityResolver` is NOT dead code

Re-verified against current HEAD: `IdentityResolver` is live production code, reached from `callisto-moon`'s WASM PDK plugin entry points (`extension.rs`'s `execute_extension`/`initialize_extension` → `MoonProjectLocator::new`/`resolve_id`). `walk.rs`'s comment about it being unused refers only to `callisto-graph`'s own primary walk path bypassing it — a different caller.

Routing it through `Manifest::open()` + `.package_name()` (the original task's suggested fix) turns out to be unsafe as a drop-in: `CargoToml::open()` hard-errors on any workspace-inheriting `Cargo.toml` (`.workspace = true` on version/deps) unless the caller supplies a real `cargo_workspace: Some(WorkspaceInheritance)` context. `IdentityResolver`'s current hand-rolled parsing never needs that context (it only reads `[package].name`, which Cargo doesn't support inheriting) and `MoonProjectLocator` has no `WorkspaceInheritance` machinery today. Blindly switching to `Manifest::open()` would regress `callisto-moon` for any workspace-inheriting Cargo member it locates — a real behavior change, not a safe cleanup.

**Revised, safe fix**: extract just the "parse a package name from already-read manifest content" logic — the part of each `Manifest::package_name()` impl that doesn't touch inheritance at all — into small free functions in `callisto-manifests` (one per ecosystem, or one function taking `ManifestFormat`), e.g. `callisto_manifests::parse_package_name(content: &str, format: ManifestFormat) -> Result<String, ManifestError>`. Have both the three `Manifest::package_name()` implementations and `IdentityResolver::resolve` call it. This removes the real duplication with zero behavior change and no new context-threading requirement. Test by asserting `IdentityResolver::resolve` and the corresponding `Manifest::package_name()` produce identical results across Cargo/Npm/Pypi fixtures, including a workspace-inheriting Cargo fixture (proving `IdentityResolver` still works on it post-fix, which is the property that made the naive approach unsafe).

### #15 in detail — AGPL fixtures: remove, not extract or document

Re-verified: `callisto-fixtures` (AGPL-3.0-only) is declared as a dev-dependency in both `callisto-model/Cargo.toml` and `callisto-format/Cargo.toml`, but grep confirms **zero** `callisto_fixtures::` usages anywhere in either crate's test code (both have only inline `#[cfg(test)]` modules, no `tests/` directories, and use nothing from the fixtures crate). The original task's two options (document an exception, or extract a shared MIT/Apache fixtures crate) both assumed real usage existed. Since it doesn't, the fix is simpler than either: **delete the two dev-dependency lines**. Verify with `cargo test -p callisto-model -p callisto-format` after removal (should be a no-op for test results) and `cargo tree -p callisto-model -p callisto-format` to confirm AGPL-licensed `callisto-fixtures` no longer appears in either crate's dependency tree at all, even as a dev-dep.

## Phase C — Performance (#16–18)

- **#16 — `plan_publish` GitAccess consolidation.** Currently 2 `GitAccess::discover` calls (head_sha + implicit one inside `ws.tags()`), not 1. Consolidate into one shared instance built once at the top of `plan_publish`/`plan_version`. Add the missing dedicated test proving `plan.releases` populates correctly via the shell fallback when gix is unavailable (today only the total-failure path is tested for publish specifically — `snapshot_tests.rs` has the analogous test for snapshot; mirror it in `publish_tests.rs` or similar).
- **#17 — `matrix.rs` double manifest parse.** `assemble_platform_target_group` and `assemble_runtime_versions` each independently read+parse the same `package.json`/`pyproject.toml` per package. Read once per package into a shared value, have both extraction paths consult it.
- **#18 — `create_tags` tag-list reuse.** Expose `TagIndex`'s already-fetched raw tag list; have `create_tags_with_options` check existence against that in-memory set instead of re-querying `git tag --list` per release.

## Phase D — Dependency hygiene (#19–24)

All mechanical, low-risk, single-crate `Cargo.toml`/small-function changes. **Proposed batching** (still individually tested, but grouped into fewer commits than one-per-item, since none of these involve meaningful new test coverage the way Phases A–C do — a `cargo test` + `cargo tree` check after each is the real verification, not a red/green TDD cycle):

- **Commit 1** (`#19` + `#20`, "path handling"): `workspace_relative` → use `camino`/`path-slash` instead of hand-rolled `.replace('\\', "/")` (byte-incorrect on Unix today — a real bug, not just style); apply `dunce::canonicalize` at the 3 remaining raw-`.canonicalize()` sites (`locate/root.rs`, `locate/ignore_walk.rs`, `callisto-cli`'s `workspace.rs`/`commands/pre.rs`), adding `dunce` as a dependency to `callisto-graph`/`callisto-cli`.
- **Commit 2** (`#21` + `#22` + `#23`, "Cargo.toml/dependency cleanup"): move `tempfile` to `[dev-dependencies]` in `callisto-changelog`; remove the unused `serde_yaml` dependency + the dead `ConfigError::ParseYaml` variant from `callisto-graph` (re-verified this session: zero usages, `pnpm-workspace.yaml` is only existence-checked today, never parsed — removal is correct, not a stub for a feature nobody's asked for); use `semver::VersionReq` in `check_git_version` instead of hand-rolled major.minor string splitting.
- **Commit 3** (`#24`, "workspace dependency centralization"): convert re-pinned `tempfile`/`miette`/`petgraph` declarations to `{ workspace = true }`; add `proptest`/`schemars` to `[workspace.dependencies]` and point the 3-4 crates using each at the centralized version.

If any of these turns out to have a real behavioral wrinkle once touched (e.g. `camino`/`path-slash`'s exact semantics differing from the hand-rolled version in some edge case), it gets split back out into its own commit rather than forced into the batch.

## Phase E — Documentation (#25–29)

Also batched, since these are prose/doc-comment changes with no code-behavior risk:

- **Commit 1** (`#25` + `#26`, "spec doc crate coverage"): add the missing `callisto matrix` section to `docs/00-design.md` and `docs/01-spec.md` (§SPEC-004, schema, platform-triple table, AC references); add `callisto-vcs` to the crate-letter legend, dependency diagram, and give it a full spec section; correct "nine crates" → "ten."
- **Commit 2** (`#27` + `#28`, "code doc comments"): doc-comment `DiagnosticCode`'s (now 20) variants, `solve_cascade`, `RateLimitPolicy`/`TimeProvider`, `REQUIRED_GIT`, `RuntimeEcosystem` — bring density in line with each file's already-documented neighbors.
- **Commit 3** (`#29`, "ARCHITECTURE.md corrections"): fix the false `pulldown-cmark` dependency claim; rename/reconcile the "Permissive" `Layer1` subgraph label (contains 2 AGPL crates) between `ARCHITECTURE.md` and `CLAUDE.md`'s narrower "Layer 1" definition.

## Phase F — Newly-discovered items (#30–31)

Real behavior fixes discovered by reviewers during Phases already shipped; kept as their own commits like Phase A–C, not batched.

- **#30 — Git subprocess stderr redaction.** Same `redact_known_secrets`/`known_credential_env_values` machinery from task #2, applied to the 5 different call sites found in `apply.rs`, `validate.rs`, `shell.rs`, `callisto-moon/runner.rs`, `pre_cursor.rs`. Extend the known-name list with `GITHUB_TOKEN`/`GH_TOKEN` (realistic exposure: GitHub Actions' `REDACTED` authenticated remote URL pattern, catchable by the existing URL-userinfo redaction alone, but the explicit env-var name coverage is cheap insurance).
- **#31 — Wire up `IdentityIndex.platform`.** `walk.rs`'s identity-building loop already computes `ManifestRole::Platform` via `detect_npm_role` and pushes a `ManifestDecl` into `decls` (used for publish routing) but never inserts into `IdentityIndex.platform` — so `config/groups.rs::resolve()` can never construct real `GroupMember::PlatformManifest` entries, and `napi_drift` always compares against an empty `member_triples`, regardless of task #6's ABI fix. Fix: insert `(platform_package_name, (primary_id, manifest_rel))` into `index.platform` alongside the existing `decls.push()`. Verify with an end-to-end test using a real `detect_npm_role`-discovered `package.json` feeding into `napi_drift` (not the existing tests' hand-constructed `GroupMember::PlatformManifest` fixtures, which bypass this wiring and wouldn't have caught the gap in the first place).

---

## Verification (applies throughout, every commit)

- Targeted: `cargo test -p <crate> --lib -- <module>::tests` after each red/green cycle.
- Per-commit: full `cargo test -p <touched crates>`, `cargo clippy -p <touched crates> --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt`.
- Periodically (end of each phase, and definitely before the final wrap-up): `cargo build --workspace` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` to catch cross-crate exhaustive-match/enum-variant issues (several tasks add enum variants or new error cases that could need this).
- Final gate after Phase F: full `just ci` (fmt-check, lint, test, audit, doc-check, wasm-check, coverage), matching how Spec A/B and the original 8-bug remediation pass each closed out.
- Update `ACTIVE.md` and memory once all 31 tasks are shipped, same as after Spec A/B.

content.subject: Redact secrets from subprocess stderr before embedding in reports/logs
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish_client.rs embeds raw subprocess stderr verbatim into RegistryError/PublishReport JSON and CI logs with zero scrubbing. content.subject: Bound subprocess stdout/stderr buffer size

Cap accumulated output at a fixed size with a "[output truncated]" marker while still draining the pipe to avoid reintroducing the deadlock commit 6e16212 fixed.

content.subject: Fix Cargo dependency-spec silent no-op for unrecognized value shapes
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/cargo.rs: CargoToml::update_dependency_spec (~347-374) and WorkspaceCargoResolver::write_dependency (~684-699) both fall through to Ok(()) with zero mutation when a dependency TOML value is neither string nor table. Add a trailing else/error branch to both, same pattern in both places.

content.subject: Fix bare 401/403 substring auth-failure misclassification
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish_client.rs detect_auth_failure (~697-709) does bare .contains("401")/.contains("403") with no word-boundary guard, unlike the adjacent detect_rate_limit's guard against bare "429". A byte count like "140312" would misclassify as AuthFailed. Add the same contextual co-occurrence guard.

content.subject: Fix detect_npm_role/role_to_triple ABI mismatch for Linux napi targets
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/walk.rs detect_npm_role (~454) always sets abi: None, but napi.rs::role_to_triple's Linux match arms all require Some("gnu")/Some("musl")/Some("gnueabihf") — a real disk-discovered Linux napi package can never round-trip. Give detect_npm_role access to ABI inference (napi-rs package-name suffix convention) or make role_to_triple treat abi:None as a wildcard on Linux.

content.subject: Add PEP 503 normalization to Python dependency-name matching
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/python.rs update_dependency_spec (line 330) and update_optional_dependencies (line 458) only case-fold names (.eq_ignore_ascii_case), not PEP 503 separator equivalence (-/_/. interchangeable). Apply the same PEP 503 normalization already used for the PyPI wheel-filename glob in publish_client.rs's pypi_publish.

content.subject: Dedupe platform triples in matrix.rs
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs assemble_platform_target_group (306-338) doesn't dedupe triples read from napi.targets/[tool.maturin].targets before building PlatformTargets — a copy-paste duplicate in a hand-maintained manifest produces duplicate CI matrix jobs. Dedupe before construction; optionally warn on a dropped duplicate.

content.subject: Add PackageId::resolve_unique() safe API and migrate remaining .find()-over-matches() site
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/identity.rs PackageId::matches() returns a bare bool for an ambiguity-prone operation; commit 84e3a73 fixed 2 call sites by hand (aggregate.rs, status.rs) but never added a safe API, so the pattern isn't enforced. Add a resolve_unique() method encapsulating collect-and-error, migrate the two already-fixed call sites to use it, and migrate crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs's resolve_package_config (still first-match .find()) if that call site's semantics genuinely need uniqueness (verify it's not intentionally most-specific-wins first).

content.subject: Convert PreMajorInferencePolicy to a proper 3-state enum
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs PreMajorInferencePolicy (135-146) models a closed 3-state policy as two independent public bools, permitting an unreachable-via-parser 4th combination via plain struct literal. Replace with enum PreMajorInferencePolicy { Off, Conservative, ConservativeFeat }, update parse_pre_major_policy and all call sites.

content.subject: Split PackageIdParseError::PathTraversal from leading-hyphen error
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/identity.rs reuses PackageIdParseError::PathTraversal (message "contains path traversal `..`") for the unrelated leading-hyphen check (lines 31-32, 46-47, 64-65, 226-227) even when the input has no "..". Add a dedicated LeadingHyphen variant with an accurate message; add message-content assertions to the existing test.

content.subject: Model PublishTarget::Npm access as a 3-state enum instead of bool
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/npm.rs PublishTarget::Npm.restricted: bool collapses absent/public/restricted npm access into two states, forcing crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs (~224) to re-derive scope via starts_with('@') string-sniffing. content.subject: Resolve IdentityResolver duplication — delete if dead, else route through Manifest trait
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/identity.rs IdentityResolver::resolve hand-parses manifests directly instead of using callisto-manifests' Manifest::package_name(). Verify (walk.rs:58-63 suggests it may no longer be called at all, having been replaced by locator-resolved proj.id) whether IdentityResolver has any live callers; if dead, remove it; if live, route it through the Manifest trait's open()/.package_name() instead of duplicating the parsing.

content.subject: Add probe/quiet mode to CommandRunner for existence-check subprocess calls
content.description: crates/callisto-cli/src/runner.rs unconditionally streams subprocess stderr live with no "internal probe" signal. SubprocessRegistryClient::npm_is_published's npm view existence check streams raw npm stderr live even on the expected 404-shaped "not published yet" result, looking like a failure during every first-time publish. Add a run_quiet/probe variant to CommandRunner and use it for is_published-style calls; reserve live streaming for the actual mutating publish() call.

content.subject: Resolve Layer 1 AGPL dev-dependency on callisto-fixtures
content.description: crates/callisto-model/Cargo.toml and crates/callisto-format/Cargo.toml both dev-depend on AGPL-licensed callisto-fixtures, contradicting CLAUDE.md invariant #4's "Layer 1 must never depend on AGPL crates" (no dev-dependency carve-out stated). content.subject: Consolidate plan_publish to one shared GitAccess + add fallback test
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs still performs 2 independent GitAccess::discover calls (head_sha at line 111, plus one implicit inside ws.tags()->TagIndex::build) instead of 1 shared instance the way status() now does it (commit 7634e5f). content.subject: Eliminate matrix.rs's double manifest parse per package
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs assemble_platform_target_group (63-246) and assemble_runtime_versions (368-396) each independently read+parse the same package.json/pyproject.toml per package. Read/parse each manifest once per package into a shared value; have both extraction paths consult it.

content.subject: Reuse TagIndex's tag list in create_tags instead of re-querying git
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/tag.rs create_tags_with_options (line 79) calls git.list_tags per release as an existence check even though TagIndex::build already fetched the full tag list once via fetch_all_tags. content.subject: Fix workspace_relative to use camino/path-slash instead of hand-rolled parsing
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/path.rs workspace_relative() hand-rolls path normalization with .replace('\\', "/") which is byte-incorrect on Unix (treats a literal backslash, a legal filename byte, as a separator). camino and path-slash are both already declared workspace dependencies with zero usages anywhere. input.description: Review PackageId::resolve_unique fix
input.prompt:
Workspace root: /Users/gabe/Projects/callisto (Rust monorepo). STRICTLY READ-ONLY — do not run git stash/checkout/reset/clean, do not edit any files, do not commit anything.

Review the uncommitted working-tree changes (run `git diff -- crates/callisto-model/src/identity.rs crates/callisto-graph/src/aggregate.rs`).

Context: `PackageId::matches()` returns a bare bool for an ambiguity-prone operation — its own doc comment requires every caller to hand-roll a "collect all matches, error if 2+" pattern to avoid silently taking the first match in a polyglot workspace (e.g. a bare name matching both a Cargo and an npm package). Previously only one real implementation of this pattern existed, in `crates/callisto-graph/src/aggregate.rs`'s `resolve_target_package` (operating over `&Package`), with `status.rs` just calling that function rather than duplicating it — so the actual duplication was narrower than originally scoped, but there was still no reusable primitive at the `PackageId`/`callisto-model` layer itself for a caller that only has bare `PackageId`s (not `Package`s) to resolve against.

The fix: added `pub fn resolve_unique<'a, T>(&self, items: impl Iterator<Item = &'a T>, id_of: impl Fn(&'a T) -> &'a PackageId) -> Result<Option<&'a T>, Vec<&'a T>>` to `PackageId` in `crates/callisto-model/src/identity.rs` — generic over any `T` via an `id_of` projection function, so it works for both `&PackageId` directly (`id_of = |id| id`) and `&Package` (`id_of = |p| &p.id`). Returns `Ok(None)` (no match), `Ok(Some(item))` (unique match), or `Err(candidates)` (2+ matches — caller decides how to report). `aggregate::resolve_target_package` was refactored to call it internally instead of duplicating its own collect-and-compare loop, converting the `Err(Vec<&Package>)` into `GraphError::AmbiguousName`. 4 new tests for `resolve_unique` in `identity.rs`, no new tests needed for `resolve_target_package` since it's a behavior-preserving refactor of already-tested code.

Also relevant: the review brief for this fix considered migrating `crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs`'s `resolve_package_config` (which does `.find()` first-match, prefixed-before-bare, NOT collect-and-error) to use this new API too, but decided NOT to — that function has deliberately different "most-specific-wins" semantics (confirmed by an existing test, `resolve_package_config_prefixed_beats_bare_when_bare_declared_first`, asserting a prefixed rule wins over an earlier-declared bare rule). Independently verify this reasoning is sound — read `resolve_package_config` and that test yourself and confirm migrating it to `resolve_unique` really would change behavior (not just theoretically).

Review dimensions:
1. **Correctness of `resolve_unique`'s generics/lifetimes**: any lifetime or borrow issue? Does it compile cleanly (already confirmed by me via full build, but verify the design is sound, not just "happens to compile")? Is the `id_of` closure approach the right shape, or would something simpler have worked (e.g. requiring `T: AsRef<PackageId>` or similar) — not asking you to prefer style, just confirm no genuine functional gap.
2. **Behavior-preservation of the `resolve_target_package` refactor**: trace through both the empty/single/ambiguous cases by hand and confirm the refactored version produces byte-identical `GraphError::AmbiguousName` output (same `name`, same `candidates` ordering) as the original inline implementation would have.

content.subject: Fix git ref-name leading-hyphen injection
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/tag.rs is_valid_git_ref_name has no leading-hyphen check; a tag-template like "-f{version}" renders to "-f1.0.0" which git interprets as a flag. Add the check, and as defense-in-depth insert "--" before the ref-name arg in ShellGit::create_tag/create_floating_major (crates/callisto-vcs/src/shell.rs).

content.subject: Redact secrets from subprocess stderr before embedding in reports/logs
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish_client.rs embeds raw subprocess stderr verbatim into RegistryError/PublishReport JSON and CI logs with zero scrubbing. Add a redaction pass (strip URL userinfo, known token env-var values) before wrapping stderr into any error/report type.

content.subject: Bound subprocess stdout/stderr buffer size
content.description: crates/callisto-cli/src/runner.rs's run/run_with_timeout capture stdout/stderr with no byte cap (only the 300s wall-clock timeout bounds anything). Cap accumulated output at a fixed size with a "[output truncated]" marker while still draining the pipe to avoid reintroducing the deadlock commit 6e16212 fixed.

content.subject: Fix Cargo dependency-spec silent no-op for unrecognized value shapes
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/cargo.rs: CargoToml::update_dependency_spec (~347-374) and WorkspaceCargoResolver::write_dependency (~684-699) both fall through to Ok(()) with zero mutation when a dependency TOML value is neither string nor table. Add a trailing else/error branch to both, same pattern in both places.

content.subject: Fix bare 401/403 substring auth-failure misclassification
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish_client.rs detect_auth_failure (~697-709) does bare .contains("401")/.contains("403") with no word-boundary guard, unlike the adjacent detect_rate_limit's guard against bare "429". A byte count like "140312" would misclassify as AuthFailed. Add the same contextual co-occurrence guard.

content.subject: Fix detect_npm_role/role_to_triple ABI mismatch for Linux napi targets
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/walk.rs detect_npm_role (~454) always sets abi: None, but napi.rs::role_to_triple's Linux match arms all require Some("gnu")/Some("musl")/Some("gnueabihf") — a real disk-discovered Linux napi package can never round-trip. input.prompt:
Workspace root: /Users/gabe/Projects/callisto (Rust monorepo). STRICTLY READ-ONLY — do not run git stash/checkout/reset/clean, do not edit any files, do not commit anything.

Review the uncommitted working-tree changes (run `git diff -- crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs crates/callisto-graph/src/aggregate.rs`).

Context: `PreMajorInferencePolicy` (a pre-1.0 severity-downgrade policy in `crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs`) modeled a closed 3-state choice as a struct with two independent public bools (`breaking_to_minor`, `feat_to_patch`), which permitted a 4th, unreachable-via-parser combination via a plain struct literal (`{breaking_to_minor: false, feat_to_patch: true}`).

The fix: converted it to `enum PreMajorInferencePolicy { Off, Conservative, ConservativeFeat }` (Off is `#[default]`). `parse_pre_major_policy` now returns the enum variants directly instead of struct literals. `aggregate.rs`'s `apply_pre_major` was updated: the early-return `if policy == PreMajorInferencePolicy::OFF` became `::Off`, and the downgrade `match (policy, inferred) { (p, Severity::Major) if p.breaking_to_minor => ..., (p, Severity::Minor) if p.feat_to_patch => ..., (_, s) => (s, false) }` became an exhaustive match on `(PreMajorInferencePolicy, Severity)` tuples using `Conservative | ConservativeFeat` for the Major arm and `ConservativeFeat` alone for the Minor arm. All `PreMajorInferencePolicy::OFF` references (a `pub const OFF: Self` on the old struct) were renamed to `PreMajorInferencePolicy::Off` throughout `aggregate.rs` (5 call sites: line ~105, ~215, and 3 in test code).

New tests: `apply_pre_major_off_never_downgrades`, `apply_pre_major_conservative_downgrades_major_to_minor_only`, `apply_pre_major_conservative_feat_downgrades_both_levels` (in `aggregate.rs`), `parse_pre_major_policy_parses_all_known_variants`, `parse_pre_major_policy_rejects_unknown_string` (in `config/resolve.rs`) — these are direct unit tests for functions that previously only had indirect integration-style coverage through full `callisto.toml`-loading tests.

Review dimensions:
1. **Behavioral equivalence of the match rewrite**: trace through all 6 (policy × relevant-severity) combinations by hand (Off/Conservative/ConservativeFeat × Major/Minor/other) and confirm the new exhaustive match produces IDENTICAL results to the old guard-based match for every case, including the "other severity" fallthrough (`(_, s) => (s, false)`) which still needs to handle Patch/None-type severities correctly regardless of policy.
2. **Completeness of the rename**: grep the ENTIRE workspace (not just the two files in the diff) for `PreMajorInferencePolicy::OFF`, `.breaking_to_minor`, `.feat_to_patch`, or any other reference to the old struct shape that might have been missed (e.g. in `callisto-cli`, `callisto-moon`, doc comments, or JSON schema generation via `schemars` if this type derives `JsonSchema` anywhere).
3. **`#[derive(Default)]` correctness**: confirm `PreMajorInferencePolicy::default()` now returns `Off` (via `#[default]` attribute) and that this matches the OLD struct's derived-Default behavior (`{breaking_to_minor: false, feat_to_patch: false}`, which was equivalent to `OFF`) — i.e. no default-value regression for whatever code path relies on `.unwrap_or_default()` or similar.
4. **Test quality**: run `cargo test -p callisto-graph --lib -- aggregate::tests::apply_pre_major config::resolve::tests::parse_pre_major_policy` yourself (don't infer) and confirm all 5 new tests pass. Also run the two pre-existing integration tests (`test_aggregate_pre_major_inference_policy_applied`, `test_pre_major_inference_prefixed_beats_bare_when_bare_declared_first`) to confirm the enum conversion didn't silently change end-to-end config-driven behavior.
5. **Does the enum genuinely close the gap the audit named?** Confirm by trying (mentally or by checking the type) whether the old 4th invalid combination is now actually unconstructable — i.e. there is no way to write code that produces a `PreMajorInferencePolicy` equivalent to the old `{breaking_to_minor: false, feat_to_patch: true}` state.
6. **Scope check**: does the diff touch anything beyond the described struct-to-enum conversion, match rewrite, renames, and the 5 new tests?

Report a concise verdict (under 300 words unless you find a real problem) — confirm the fix is correct and complete, or identify exactly what's wrong with file:line.

content.subject: Fix git ref-name leading-hyphen injection
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/tag.rs is_valid_git_ref_name has no leading-hyphen check; a tag-template like "-f{version}" renders to "-f1.0.0" which git interprets as a flag. Add the check, and as defense-in-depth insert "--" before the ref-name arg in ShellGit::create_tag/create_floating_major (crates/callisto-vcs/src/shell.rs).

content.subject: Redact secrets from subprocess stderr before embedding in reports/logs
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish_client.rs embeds raw subprocess stderr verbatim into RegistryError/PublishReport JSON and CI logs with zero scrubbing. Add a redaction pass (strip URL userinfo, known token env-var values) before wrapping stderr into any error/report type.

content.subject: Bound subprocess stdout/stderr buffer size
content.description: crates/callisto-cli/src/runner.rs's run/run_with_timeout capture stdout/stderr with no byte cap (only the 300s wall-clock timeout bounds anything). Cap accumulated output at a fixed size with a "[output truncated]" marker while still draining the pipe to avoid reintroducing the deadlock commit 6e16212 fixed.

content.subject: Fix Cargo dependency-spec silent no-op for unrecognized value shapes
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/cargo.rs: CargoToml::update_dependency_spec (~347-374) and WorkspaceCargoResolver::write_dependency (~684-699) both fall through to Ok(()) with zero mutation when a dependency TOML value is neither string nor table. Add a trailing else/error branch to both, same pattern in both places.

content.subject: Fix bare 401/403 substring auth-failure misclassification
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish_client.rs detect_auth_failure (~697-709) does bare .contains("401")/.contains("403") with no word-boundary guard, unlike the adjacent detect_rate_limit's guard against bare "429". A byte count like "140312" would misclassify as AuthFailed. Add the same contextual co-occurrence guard.

content.subject: Fix detect_npm_role/role_to_triple ABI mismatch for Linux napi targets
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/walk.rs detect_npm_role (~454) always sets abi: None, but napi.rs::role_to_triple's Linux match arms all require Some("gnu")/Some("musl")/Some("gnueabihf") — a real disk-discovered Linux napi package can never round-trip. Give detect_npm_role access to ABI inference (napi-rs package-name suffix convention) or make role_to_triple treat abi:None as a wildcard on Linux.

content.subject: Add PEP 503 normalization to Python dependency-name matching
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/python.rs update_dependency_spec (line 330) and update_optional_dependencies (line 458) only case-fold names (.eq_ignore_ascii_case), not PEP 503 separator equivalence (-/_/. interchangeable). Apply the same PEP 503 normalization already used for the PyPI wheel-filename glob in publish_client.rs's pypi_publish.

content.subject: Dedupe platform triples in matrix.rs
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs assemble_platform_target_group (306-338) doesn't dedupe triples read from napi.targets/[tool.maturin].targets before building PlatformTargets — a copy-paste duplicate in a hand-maintained manifest produces duplicate CI matrix jobs. Dedupe before construction; optionally warn on a dropped duplicate.

content.subject: Add PackageId::resolve_unique() safe API and migrate remaining .find()-over-matches() site
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/identity.rs PackageId::matches() returns a bare bool for an ambiguity-prone operation; commit 84e3a73 fixed 2 call sites by hand (aggregate.rs, status.rs) but never added a safe API, so the pattern isn't enforced. Add a resolve_unique() method encapsulating collect-and-error, migrate the two already-fixed call sites to use it, and migrate crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs's resolve_package_config (still first-match .find()) if that call site's semantics genuinely need uniqueness (verify it's not intentionally most-specific-wins first).

content.subject: Convert PreMajorInferencePolicy to a proper 3-state enum
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs PreMajorInferencePolicy (135-146) models a closed 3-state policy as two independent public bools, permitting an unreachable-via-parser 4th combination via plain struct literal. Replace with enum PreMajorInferencePolicy { Off, Conservative, ConservativeFeat }, update parse_pre_major_policy and all call sites.

content.subject: Split PackageIdParseError::PathTraversal from leading-hyphen error
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/identity.rs reuses PackageIdParseError::PathTraversal (message "contains path traversal `..`") for the unrelated leading-hyphen check (lines 31-32, 46-47, 64-65, 226-227) even when the input has no "..". Add a dedicated LeadingHyphen variant with an accurate message; add message-content assertions to the existing test.

content.subject: Model PublishTarget::Npm access as a 3-state enum instead of bool
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/npm.rs PublishTarget::Npm.restricted: bool collapses absent/public/restricted npm access into two states, forcing crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs (~224) to re-derive scope via starts_with('@') string-sniffing. Model as access: Option<NpmAccess> reusing the existing NpmAccess enum.

content.subject: Resolve IdentityResolver duplication — delete if dead, else route through Manifest trait
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/identity.rs IdentityResolver::resolve hand-parses manifests directly instead of using callisto-manifests' Manifest::package_name(). Verify (walk.rs:58-63 suggests it may no longer be called at all, having been replaced by locator-resolved proj.id) whether IdentityResolver has any live callers; if dead, remove it; if live, route it through the Manifest trait's open()/.package_name() instead of duplicating the parsing.

content.subject: Add probe/quiet mode to CommandRunner for existence-check subprocess calls
content.description: crates/callisto-cli/src/runner.rs unconditionally streams subprocess stderr live with no "internal probe" signal. SubprocessRegistryClient::npm_is_published's npm view existence check streams raw npm stderr live even on the expected 404-shaped "not published yet" result, looking like a failure during every first-time publish. Add a run_quiet/probe variant to CommandRunner and use it for is_published-style calls; reserve live streaming for the actual mutating publish() call.

content.subject: Resolve Layer 1 AGPL dev-dependency on callisto-fixtures
content.description: crates/callisto-model/Cargo.toml and crates/callisto-format/Cargo.toml both dev-depend on AGPL-licensed callisto-fixtures, contradicting CLAUDE.md invariant #4's "Layer 1 must never depend on AGPL crates" (no dev-dependency carve-out stated). Either document the dev-only exception explicitly in ARCHITECTURE.md, or extract the shared test doubles into a small MIT/Apache dev-fixtures crate — decide which with the user before implementing.

content.subject: Consolidate plan_publish to one shared GitAccess + add fallback test
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs still performs 2 independent GitAccess::discover calls (head_sha at line 111, plus one implicit inside ws.tags()->TagIndex::build) instead of 1 shared instance the way status() now does it (commit 7634e5f). Consolidate into one shared GitAccess, and add a dedicated publish_tests.rs test proving plan.releases populates correctly via the shell fallback when gix is unavailable (currently only the total-git-failure path is tested for publish).

content.subject: Eliminate matrix.rs's double manifest parse per package
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs assemble_platform_target_group (63-246) and assemble_runtime_versions (368-396) each independently read+parse the same package.json/pyproject.toml per package. Read/parse each manifest once per package into a shared value; have both extraction paths consult it.

content.subject: Reuse TagIndex's tag list in create_tags instead of re-querying git
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/tag.rs create_tags_with_options (line 79) calls git.list_tags per release as an existence check even though TagIndex::build already fetched the full tag list once via fetch_all_tags. Expose the raw tag list from TagIndex and check existence against that in-memory set first.

content.subject: Fix workspace_relative to use camino/path-slash instead of hand-rolled parsing
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/path.rs workspace_relative() hand-rolls path normalization with .replace('\\', "/") which is byte-incorrect on Unix (treats a literal backslash, a legal filename byte, as a separator). camino and path-slash are both already declared workspace dependencies with zero usages anywhere. Use camino::Utf8PathBuf::from_path_buf() and path_slash::PathExt::to_slash(), or remove the unused deps if the hand-rolled logic turns out intentional (unlikely given the confirmed Unix bug).

content.subject: Apply dunce::canonicalize consistently at remaining path-canonicalization sites
content.description: Only callisto-vcs/src/lib.rs:200 uses dunce::canonicalize (strips Windows \\?\ extended-length prefixes); crates/callisto-graph/src/locate/root.rs:7, locate/ignore_walk.rs:24, callisto-cli/src/workspace.rs:13 (load_workspace), and callisto-cli/src/commands/pre.rs:124 all call raw std::path::Path::canonicalize(). Add dunce as a dependency to callisto-graph/callisto-cli and replace all four raw calls.

content.subject: Move tempfile to dev-dependencies in callisto-changelog
content.description: crates/callisto-changelog/Cargo.toml declares tempfile under [dependencies] but every usage (write.rs:198,239,283,318,352) is inside #[cfg(test)]. Move to [dev-dependencies].

content.subject: Remove unused serde_yaml dependency and dead GraphError::ParseYaml variant
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/Cargo.toml declares serde_yaml with zero usages anywhere in src; GraphError::ParseYaml (error.rs:289) is never constructed. Remove both, or wire up real YAML parsing (e.g. for pnpm-workspace.yaml, referenced but never parsed) with a maintained replacement if that's actually wanted — confirm with the user which before implementing.

content.subject: Use semver crate in check_git_version instead of hand-rolled parsing
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/exec.rs check_git_version (93-122) hand-splits on '.' with .unwrap_or(0) fallbacks that silently coerce non-numeric segments to 0, instead of using semver::VersionReq (already a workspace dep, already imported by callisto_model::version in the same crate). Parse REQUIRED_GIT itself via semver to derive the comparison floor; surface a distinct diagnostic on genuine parse failure instead of silently defaulting to zero.

content.subject: Centralize re-pinned workspace dependencies
content.description: tempfile (5 crates), miette (callisto-cli), petgraph (callisto-graph) re-declare versions locally instead of {workspace = true}. proptest (4 crates) and schemars (3 crates) are used identically across multiple crates but never centralized in [workspace.dependencies] at all. Convert re-pinned deps to workspace=true; add proptest/schemars to [workspace.dependencies].

content.subject: Document callisto matrix in docs/00-design.md and docs/01-spec.md
content.description: docs/00-design.md has zero mentions of matrix/PlatformTarget/MatrixReport/napi-maturin auto-discovery. docs/01-spec.md has exactly one incidental reference to "§SPEC-004" with no actual SPEC-004 section, despite code doc comments referencing AC-001 through AC-018. Add a full crate-letter-numbered section to docs/01-spec.md (schema, platform-triple table, acceptance criteria) and a narrative section to docs/00-design.md.

content.subject: Add callisto-vcs to crate architecture docs
content.description: docs/01-spec.md says "Nine crates" (there are ten); the crate-letter legend (lines 55-58) has no letter for callisto-vcs; the ASCII dependency diagram (70-90) has no callisto-vcs box and a misaligned callisto-changelog row. callisto-vcs is only mentioned in a late appendix (§13.6). Add callisto-vcs to the crate-letter legend, give it a full spec section matching the other nine crates, fix the diagram, correct "nine" to "ten."

content.subject: Doc-comment DiagnosticCode enum and its variants
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/diagnostic.rs DiagnosticCode enum (91-108, now 20 variants) has zero doc comments on the enum or any variant — this is the discriminator serialized into every JSON diagnostic and consumed by CI tooling. Doc-comment each variant with its trigger condition and default severity, mirroring the density already present on RegistryError's variants.

content.subject: Doc-comment solve_cascade, RateLimitPolicy, TimeProvider, REQUIRED_GIT, RuntimeEcosystem
content.description: Five undocumented public API surfaces on freshly-touched or architecturally central code, each inconsistent with well-documented siblings in the same file: solve_cascade (crates/callisto-graph/src/cascade.rs:167, the ~200-line worklist algorithm at the heart of the largest crate), RateLimitPolicy/TimeProvider (crates/callisto-model/src/registry.rs:79-86, the retry/backoff extension points), REQUIRED_GIT (crates/callisto-model/src/exec.rs:4), RuntimeEcosystem (crates/callisto-model/src/matrix.rs:84-89). content.subject: Fix ARCHITECTURE.md factual errors
content.description: ARCHITECTURE.md:123 claims callisto-changelog depends on pulldown-cmark (it doesn't — the renderer builds Markdown by hand). ARCHITECTURE.md's Layer1 mermaid subgraph (90-105) is titled "Permissive" but contains two AGPL-licensed crates (callisto-conventional, callisto-changelog), contradicting the licensing table two lines below and CLAUDE.md invariant #4's narrower "Layer 1" scope. Correct the dependency claim; rename the subgraph to avoid the permissiveness claim and reconcile "Layer 1" terminology between the two docs.

content.subject: Redact secrets from git subprocess stderr across apply.rs/validate.rs/shell.rs/callisto-moon/pre_cursor.rs
content.description: Task #2 redacted secrets from registry-CLI (cargo/npm/pypi publish) subprocess stderr in publish_client.rs's 6 sites, using callisto-model's new redact_known_secrets/known_credential_env_values. A follow-up review found the same leak shape at a different, unaddressed set of call sites: raw git stderr flows unredacted into errors at crates/callisto-graph/src/apply.rs:422,438, crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/validate.rs:30,56, crates/callisto-vcs/src/shell.rs:68,155,187,208, crates/callisto-moon/src/runner.rs:81,103, and crates/callisto-conventional/src/pre_cursor.rs:32,52. Realistic exposure: GitHub Actions commonly injects an authenticated remote URL shaped like REDACTED and git can echo it verbatim in error text on auth failure. Reuse the existing redact_known_secrets/known_credential_env_values (extend the known-name list with GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN) plus the URL-userinfo stripping already proven correct in registry.rs.

content.subject: Wire up IdentityIndex.platform so napi_drift receives real group members
content.description: Independent review of task #6 (napi Linux ABI inference fix) found a deeper, separate wiring gap: crates/callisto-graph/src/identity.rs:126's IdentityIndex.platform: BTreeMap<String, (PackageId, PathBuf)> is never populated anywhere in production code (confirmed via full-repo grep). crates/callisto-graph/src/config/groups.rs's resolve() (lines ~150,185) reads index.platform.get(name) to construct GroupMember::PlatformManifest entries that napi.rs's napi_drift() compares against napi.targets config -- but since index.platform is always empty, member_triples in napi_drift is always empty regardless of the ABI fix in walk.rs, so napi_drift will always spuriously report every declared napi target as missing from group members. walk.rs's identity-building loop (~line 55-124) already calls detect_npm_role and pushes Platform-role ManifestDecls into package_manifest_decls' decls list (used for publish routing), but never also inserts into index.platform. Fix: insert (platform_package_name, (primary_id, manifest_rel)) into index.platform alongside the existing decls.push() when a Platform role is detected, then verify napi_drift stops false-positiving with an end-to-end test using a real detect_npm_role-discovered package.json (not the existing tests' hand-constructed GroupMember::PlatformManifest fixtures, which bypass this wiring entirely and wouldn't have caught the gap).

content.subject: Dedupe platform triples in matrix.rs
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs assemble_platform_target_group (306-338) doesn't dedupe triples read from napi.targets/[tool.maturin].targets before building PlatformTargets — a copy-paste duplicate in a hand-maintained manifest produces duplicate CI matrix jobs. Dedupe before construction; optionally warn on a dropped duplicate.

content.subject: Add PackageId::resolve_unique() safe API and migrate remaining .find()-over-matches() site
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/identity.rs PackageId::matches() returns a bare bool for an ambiguity-prone operation; commit 84e3a73 fixed 2 call sites by hand (aggregate.rs, status.rs) but never added a safe API, so the pattern isn't enforced. Add a resolve_unique() method encapsulating collect-and-error, migrate the two already-fixed call sites to use it, and migrate crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs's resolve_package_config (still first-match .find()) if that call site's semantics genuinely need uniqueness (verify it's not intentionally most-specific-wins first).

content.subject: Convert PreMajorInferencePolicy to a proper 3-state enum
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs PreMajorInferencePolicy (135-146) models a closed 3-state policy as two independent public bools, permitting an unreachable-via-parser 4th combination via plain struct literal. Replace with enum PreMajorInferencePolicy { Off, Conservative, ConservativeFeat }, update parse_pre_major_policy and all call sites.

content.subject: Split PackageIdParseError::PathTraversal from leading-hyphen error
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/identity.rs reuses PackageIdParseError::PathTraversal (message "contains path traversal `..`") for the unrelated leading-hyphen check (lines 31-32, 46-47, 64-65, 226-227) even when the input has no "..". Add a dedicated LeadingHyphen variant with an accurate message; add message-content assertions to the existing test.

content.subject: Model PublishTarget::Npm access as a 3-state enum instead of bool
content.description: crates/callisto-manifests/src/npm.rs PublishTarget::Npm.restricted: bool collapses absent/public/restricted npm access into two states, forcing crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs (~224) to re-derive scope via starts_with('@') string-sniffing. Model as access: Option<NpmAccess> reusing the existing NpmAccess enum.

content.subject: Resolve IdentityResolver duplication — delete if dead, else route through Manifest trait
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/identity.rs IdentityResolver::resolve hand-parses manifests directly instead of using callisto-manifests' Manifest::package_name(). Verify (walk.rs:58-63 suggests it may no longer be called at all, having been replaced by locator-resolved proj.id) whether IdentityResolver has any live callers; if dead, remove it; if live, route it through the Manifest trait's open()/.package_name() instead of duplicating the parsing.

content.subject: Add probe/quiet mode to CommandRunner for existence-check subprocess calls
content.description: crates/callisto-cli/src/runner.rs unconditionally streams subprocess stderr live with no "internal probe" signal. SubprocessRegistryClient::npm_is_published's npm view existence check streams raw npm stderr live even on the expected 404-shaped "not published yet" result, looking like a failure during every first-time publish. Add a run_quiet/probe variant to CommandRunner and use it for is_published-style calls; reserve live streaming for the actual mutating publish() call.

content.subject: Resolve Layer 1 AGPL dev-dependency on callisto-fixtures
content.description: crates/callisto-model/Cargo.toml and crates/callisto-format/Cargo.toml both dev-depend on AGPL-licensed callisto-fixtures, contradicting CLAUDE.md invariant #4's "Layer 1 must never depend on AGPL crates" (no dev-dependency carve-out stated). Either document the dev-only exception explicitly in ARCHITECTURE.md, or extract the shared test doubles into a small MIT/Apache dev-fixtures crate — decide which with the user before implementing.

content.subject: Consolidate plan_publish to one shared GitAccess + add fallback test
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs still performs 2 independent GitAccess::discover calls (head_sha at line 111, plus one implicit inside ws.tags()->TagIndex::build) instead of 1 shared instance the way status() now does it (commit 7634e5f). Consolidate into one shared GitAccess, and add a dedicated publish_tests.rs test proving plan.releases populates correctly via the shell fallback when gix is unavailable (currently only the total-git-failure path is tested for publish).

content.subject: Eliminate matrix.rs's double manifest parse per package
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs assemble_platform_target_group (63-246) and assemble_runtime_versions (368-396) each independently read+parse the same package.json/pyproject.toml per package. Read/parse each manifest once per package into a shared value; have both extraction paths consult it.

content.subject: Reuse TagIndex's tag list in create_tags instead of re-querying git
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/tag.rs create_tags_with_options (line 79) calls git.list_tags per release as an existence check even though TagIndex::build already fetched the full tag list once via fetch_all_tags. Expose the raw tag list from TagIndex and check existence against that in-memory set first.

content.subject: Fix workspace_relative to use camino/path-slash instead of hand-rolled parsing
content.description: crates/callisto-model/src/path.rs workspace_relative() hand-rolls path normalization with .replace('\\', "/") which is byte-incorrect on Unix (treats a literal backslash, a legal filename byte, as a separator). camino and path-slash are both already declared workspace dependencies with zero usages anywhere. Use camino::Utf8PathBuf::from_path_buf() and path_slash::PathExt::to_slash(), or remove the unused deps if the hand-rolled logic turns out intentional (unlikely given the confirmed Unix bug).

content.subject: Apply dunce::canonicalize consistently at remaining path-canonicalization sites
content.description: Only callisto-vcs/src/lib.rs:200 uses dunce::canonicalize (strips Windows \\?\ extended-length prefixes); crates/callisto-graph/src/locate/root.rs:7, locate/ignore_walk.rs:24, callisto-cli/src/workspace.rs:13 (load_workspace), and callisto-cli/src/commands/pre.rs:124 all call raw std::path::Path::canonicalize(). Add dunce as a dependency to callisto-graph/callisto-cli and replace all four raw calls.

content.subject: Move tempfile to dev-dependencies in callisto-changelog

content.subject: Remove unused serde_yaml dependency and dead GraphError::ParseYaml variant
content.description: crates/callisto-graph/Cargo.toml declares serde_yaml with zero usages anywhere in src; GraphError::ParseYaml (error.rs:289) is never constructed. Remove both, or wire up real YAML parsing (e.g. for pnpm-workspace.yaml, referenced but never parsed) with a maintained replacement if that's actually wanted — confirm with the user which before implementing.

content.subject: Use semver crate in check_git_version instead of hand-rolled parsing

content.description: docs/00-design.md has zero mentions of matrix/PlatformTarget/MatrixReport/napi-maturin auto-discovery. docs/01-spec.md has exactly one incidental reference to "§SPEC-004" with no actual SPEC-004 section, despite code doc comments referencing AC-001 through AC-018. content.subject: Doc-comment solve_cascade, RateLimitPolicy, TimeProvider, REQUIRED_GIT, RuntimeEcosystem

content.subject: Fix ARCHITECTURE.md factual errors
content.description: ARCHITECTURE.md:123 claims callisto-changelog depends on pulldown-cmark (it doesn't — the renderer builds Markdown by hand). ARCHITECTURE.md's Layer1 mermaid subgraph (90-105) is titled "Permissive" but contains two AGPL-licensed crates (callisto-conventional, callisto-changelog), contradicting the licensing table two lines below and CLAUDE.md invariant #4's narrower "Layer 1" scope. Correct the dependency claim; rename the subgraph to avoid the permissiveness claim and reconcile "Layer 1" terminology between the two docs.

content.subject: Redact secrets from git subprocess stderr across apply.rs/validate.rs/shell.rs/callisto-moon/pre_cursor.rs
content.description: Task #2 redacted secrets from registry-CLI (cargo/npm/pypi publish) subprocess stderr in publish_client.rs's 6 sites, using callisto-model's new redact_known_secrets/known_credential_env_values. A follow-up review found the same leak shape at a different, unaddressed set of call sites: raw git stderr flows unredacted into errors at crates/callisto-graph/src/apply.rs:422,438, crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/validate.rs:30,56, crates/callisto-vcs/src/shell.rs:68,155,187,208, crates/callisto-moon/src/runner.rs:81,103, and crates/callisto-conventional/src/pre_cursor.rs:32,52. Realistic exposure: GitHub Actions commonly injects an authenticated remote URL shaped like REDACTED and git can echo it verbatim in error text on auth failure. Reuse the existing redact_known_secrets/known_credential_env_values (extend the known-name list with GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN) plus the URL-userinfo stripping already proven correct in registry.rs.

content.subject: Wire up IdentityIndex.platform so napi_drift receives real group members
content.description: Independent review of task #6 (napi Linux ABI inference fix) found a deeper, separate wiring gap: crates/callisto-graph/src/identity.rs:126's IdentityIndex.platform: BTreeMap<String, (PackageId, PathBuf)> is never populated anywhere in production code (confirmed via full-repo grep). crates/callisto-graph/src/config/groups.rs's resolve() (lines ~150,185) reads index.platform.get(name) to construct GroupMember::PlatformManifest entries that napi.rs's napi_drift() compares against napi.targets config -- but since index.platform is always empty, member_triples in napi_drift is always empty regardless of the ABI fix in walk.rs, so napi_drift will always spuriously report every declared napi target as missing from group members. walk.rs's identity-building loop (~line 55-124) already calls detect_npm_role and pushes Platform-role ManifestDecls into package_manifest_decls' decls list (used for publish routing), but never also inserts into index.platform. Fix: insert (platform_package_name, (primary_id, manifest_rel)) into index.platform alongside the existing decls.push() when a Platform role is detected, then verify napi_drift stops false-positiving with an end-to-end test using a real detect_npm_role-discovered package.json (not the existing tests' hand-constructed GroupMember::PlatformManifest fixtures, which bypass this wiring entirely and wouldn't have caught the gap).
